prompts.title: 霓虹夜景摄影创作 01
prompts.description: 适合商业摄影师制作摄影与人像素材，重点控制复古胶片、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt: Cinematic night-time selfie of a young woman riding through a city, shot from a low wide-angle perspective. Soft, dreamy motion blur with long light trails from streetlights and traffic creating a cyberpunk glow. Neon blue, teal, and warm amber lights streak across the background. Shallow depth of field, slightly grainy film texture, subtle chromatic aberration. Natural makeup, loose hair flowing in the wind, calm and introspective expression. Urban nightlife atmosphere, moody and ethereal, analog photography feel, high contrast lighting, artistic street photography, 35mm film look.

prompts.promptZh: 一位年轻女子骑马穿过城市的电影夜间自拍照，从低广角视角拍摄。柔和、梦幻的运动模糊，路灯和交通发出的长光迹营造出赛博朋克的光芒。霓虹蓝、青色和温暖的琥珀色灯光在背景上划过。景深较浅，胶片质感稍有颗粒感，色差细微。自然的妆容，披散的头发随风飘逸，表情平静而内省。都市夜生活氛围，喜怒无常，空灵，模拟摄影感觉，高对比度灯光，艺术街头摄影，35mm胶片效果。

prompts.title: 时尚编辑产品主图 01
prompts.description: 适合产品摄影师制作电商与产品素材，重点控制写实摄影、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Edit the uploaded photo of a male model into a semi-illustrated street fashion look.
Keep the pose, camera angle, and framing exactly the same.
Illustrate only the jacket and sneakers in bold red, blue, green, yellow, and black color-pop style with clean black outlines.
Add colorful doodle motion strokes.
Face and background remain realistic.
Not full cartoon.

prompts.promptZh:
将上传的男模特照片编辑成半插图街头时尚造型。
保持姿势、相机角度和取景完全相同。
仅以大胆的红色、蓝色、绿色、黄色和黑色流行色风格和干净的黑色轮廓展示夹克和运动鞋。

脸部和背景保持真实。
不是完整的漫画。

prompts.title: 时尚编辑品牌海报 01
prompts.description: 适合广告创意制作海报与品牌素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create a stylized illustration of {anime character name} from {franchise}.

Character Analysis:

Derive the character’s core personality archetype based on canon portrayal (e.g., heroic, calm, mysterious, aggressive).
Identify the signature color from the original design and use it as the primary visual accent.

Pose & Body Language:

Generate an iconic pose that reflects the personality archetype:
Energetic / Heroic: dynamic action, wide stance, explosive movement
Calm / Confident: balanced, relaxed posture, minimal motion
Dark / Mysterious: low stance, subtle movement, sharp or hidden gaze
Aggressive / Intense: forward-leaning attack stance, visible tension, clenched fists

Facial Expression:

Match expression precisely to the character’s personality and emotional tone.

Art Style:

Anime × streetwear × graphic poster hybrid
Clean lineart, semi-flat shading, high contrast
Modern, minimal, and visually striking

Composition:

Vertical format 3:4
Off-center subject placement
Strong diagonal visual flow
Layered depth for a dynamic poster feel

Outfit Design:

Reimagine the original costume as modern streetwear / techwear
Preserve recognizable identity elements of the character

Color Palette:

Dominant clean white background
Use signature color as the primary accent
Add one secondary accent (complementary or analogous tone)
Keep palette minimal, bold, and high-contrast

Background:

Abstract geometric poster layout
Use negative space effectively
Integrate subtle accents using the character’s color theme

Effects:

Energy strokes, paint lines, and motion accents
Effects should follow the character’s energy and color identity

Lighting:

Sharp directional lighting
Crisp shadows
Subtle glow using the signature color

Rendering Quality:

Ultra-clean vector-style finish
Poster-quality composition
4K resolution, high detail

prompts.promptZh:
创建 {franchise} 中的 {anime character name} 的风格化插图。

人物分析：

根据经典描绘推导出角色的核心性格原型（例如，英雄、冷静、神秘、侵略性）。
从原始设计中识别出标志性颜色，并将其用作主要视觉重点。

姿势和肢体语言：

生成反映个性原型的标志性姿势：
精力充沛/英勇：动态动作、宽阔的站姿、爆发力的动作
平静/自信：平衡、放松的姿势、最小的运动
黑暗/神秘：低姿态、微妙的动作、锐利或隐藏的目光
攻击性/激烈：前倾的攻击姿势，明显的紧张，紧握的拳头

面部表情：

将表情与角色的个性和情绪基调精确匹配。

艺术风格：

动漫×街头服饰×图形海报混合体
干净的线条、半平面阴影、高对比度
现代、简约且具有视觉冲击力

成分：

垂直格式 3:4
偏离中心的主题放置
强烈的对角视觉流
分层深度营造动态海报感觉

服装设计：

将原始服装重新想象为现代街头服饰/科技服饰
保留角色可识别的身份元素

调色板：

以干净的白色为主背景
使用标志色作为主要强调色
添加一种次要重音（补音或类比音）
保持调色板简约、大胆和高对比度

背景：

抽象几何海报布局
有效利用负空间
使用角色的颜色主题整合微妙的口音

效果：

能量笔触、绘画线条和运动强调
效果应遵循角色的能量和颜色特征

照明：

锐利的定向照明
清晰的阴影
使用标志性颜色发出微妙的光芒

渲染质量：

超干净的矢量风格饰面
海报品质的构图
4K分辨率，高细节

prompts.title: 霓虹夜景知识信息图 01
prompts.description: 适合课程设计师制作信息图与知识素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium square “reference-style consumer technology infographic” centered around a futuristic flagship smartphone called the {SMARTPHONE_NAME}, designed as a beautifully curated product-engineering handbook page rather than a generic commercial advertisement.

The composition should feel like a modern visual encyclopedia mixed with an elite consumer-electronics field guide and high-end editorial infographic system.

Visual Direction:

• 1:1 square composition
• Dark premium tech background with subtle circuit-board textures, holographic UI overlays, and futuristic blueprint schematics
• Elegant muted palette using matte black, titanium gray, electric blue accents, graphite silver, and soft neon highlights
• Refined editorial typography hierarchy
• Rounded modular information cards with clean spacing
• Gentle realistic reflections and premium HUD-style dividers
• Minimal modern technology iconography
• Extremely detailed central smartphone render viewed in dramatic three-quarter perspective with floating studio-style lighting
• Thin precision annotation lines pointing toward hardware systems and smart features
• Clean, organized “knowledge-first” layout with high information density but breathable spacing

Main Subject Presentation:

A stunning ultra-detailed realistic render of the {SMARTPHONE_NAME} placed at the center, featuring edge-to-edge AMOLED display, premium metallic frame, realistic glass reflections, advanced camera modules, glowing UI screen graphics, ultra-thin bezels, and high-end consumer-tech realism.

Surround the smartphone with scientific and engineering callouts explaining:

• AI processor architecture
• advanced camera system
• AMOLED display technology
• battery and fast charging system
• cooling and thermal management
• connectivity systems (5G/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth)
• operating system and AI assistant
• audio and speaker technology
• durability and water resistance
• sustainable material engineering

Include modular infographic sections such as:

• Smartphone Overview
• Technical Specifications
• Dimensions & Design
• Camera System Breakdown
• Display Technology
• Processor & Performance
• Battery & Charging
• Connectivity Features
• Cooling & Durability
• Storage & Memory Configurations
• Audio Experience
• Smart OS & AI Features
• Sustainability & Eco Design
• Benchmark Performance Charts
• “Top 5 Reasons to Choose” section
• Accessories & Included Box Contents
• Ideal User Profiles

Add small premium visualization modules like:

• chipset architecture diagrams
• camera lens cutaways
• battery charging-speed charts
• UI/OS interface mockups
• connectivity icons & network visuals
• thermal cooling illustrations
• benchmark comparison graphs
• exploded hardware views
• smartphone blueprint dimensions
• accessory ecosystem visuals

Style Keywords:

“premium consumer-tech encyclopedia”
“editorial smartphone handbook”
“high-end electronics infographic”
“scientific product poster”
“museum-quality smartphone reference page”
“modular technology knowledge system”
“clean futuristic editorial design”
“ultra-detailed gadget visualization”

Avoid:

• cluttered commercial advertisement aesthetics
• cartoon futuristic styling
• unrealistic sci-fi hologram overload
• cheap e-commerce layouts
• excessive neon cyberpunk chaos
• low-detail generic phone renders

The final result should resemble a professionally published consumer-technology reference-book page created for tech enthusiasts, industrial designers, engineers, collectors, reviewers, and educational product-design archives.

prompts.promptZh:
创建一个优质的方形“参考式消费者技术信息图”，以名为 {SMARTPHONE_NAME} 的未来旗舰智能手机为中心，设计为精美的产品工程手册页面，而不是一般的商业广告。

该构图应该感觉像是一本现代视觉百科全书，混合了精英消费电子领域指南和高端编辑信息图表系统。

视觉方向：

• 1:1 方形构图
• 深色高级科技背景，带有微妙的电路板纹理、全息 UI 覆盖层和未来蓝图原理图
• 优雅柔和的调色板，采用哑光黑、钛灰色、电蓝色、石墨银和柔和的霓虹灯亮点
• 精致的编辑版式层次结构
• 圆形模块化信息卡，间距干净
• 柔和逼真的反射和高级 HUD 式分隔线
• 最小的现代技术图像
• 极其详细的中央智能手机渲染，采用浮动工作室风格照明，以戏剧性的四分之三视角观看
• 细细的精密注释线指向硬件系统和智能功能
• 干净、有组织的“知识优先”布局，信息密度高，但间距透气

主要主题介绍：

位于中心的 {SMARTPHONE_NAME} 的超详细逼真渲染令人惊叹，具有无边 AMOLED 显示屏、优质金属框架、逼真的玻璃反射、先进的摄像头模块、发光的 UI 屏幕图形、超薄边框和高端消费技术现实主义。

在智能手机周围贴上科学和工程标注，解释：

• AI处理器架构
• 先进的摄像系统
• AMOLED 显示技术
• 电池和快速充电系统
• 冷却和热管理
• 连接系统（5G/Wi-Fi/蓝牙）
• 操作系统和AI助手
• 音频和扬声器技术
• 耐用性和防水性
• 可持续材料工程

包括模块化信息图部分，例如：

• 智能手机概述
• 技术规格
• 尺寸和设计
• 摄像头系统故障
• 显示技术
• 处理器和性能
• 电池和充电
• 连接功能
• 冷却和耐用性
• 存储和内存配置
• 音频体验
• 智能操作系统和人工智能功能
• 可持续发展和生态设计
• 基准性能图表
• “选择的 5 大理由”部分
• 配件和随附的包装盒内容
• 理想的用户配置文件

添加小型高级可视化模块，例如：

• 芯片组架构图
• 相机镜头剖面图
• 电池充电速度图表
• UI/OS 界面模型
• 连接图标和网络视觉效果
• 热冷却插图
• 基准比较图
• 硬件分解视图
• 智能手机蓝图尺寸
• 附属生态系统视觉效果

风格关键词：

“优质消费科技百科全书”
“编辑智能手机手册”
“高端电子产品信息图”
“科学产品海报”
“博物馆品质的智能手机参考页面”
《模块化技术知识体系》
“干净的未来主义编辑设计”
“超详细的小工具可视化”

避免：

• 杂乱的商业广告美学
• 卡通未来派造型
• 不切实际的科幻全息图过载
• 廉价的电子商务布局
• 过度的霓虹赛博朋克混乱
• 低细节通用手机渲染

最终结果应该类似于为技术爱好者、工业设计师、工程师、收藏家、评论家和教育产品设计档案创建的专业出版的消费技术参考书页。

prompts.prompt:
(Cozy Aesthetic Girl in Park)

Aesthetic lifestyle photography of a cute young woman sitting on a wooden park bench during autumn morning, wearing an oversized beige hoodie, white pants, and cream baseball cap, holding a takeaway coffee cup with eyes closed and peaceful smile, soft natural lighting, warm earthy tones, tote bag with kawaii face design beside her, bouquet of baby’s breath flowers, cozy calm vibe, cinematic depth of field, Pinterest aesthetic, soft brown and beige color palette. Add hand-drawn white doodles around the image including hearts, sparkles, arrows, clouds, smiley faces, and handwritten text like “coffee = my love”, “good morning”, “little things”, “Focus Believe Achieve”. Whimsical scrapbook style overlay, dreamy cozy mood, ultra detailed, realistic photography, Instagram aesthetic, soft shadows, candid composition.

(Cozy Reading & Coffee Setup)

Dreamy soft aesthetic, warm natural glow, highly detailed, relaxing cozy-core vibe.

prompts.promptZh:
（公园里的温馨唯美女孩）

prompts.title: 时尚编辑角色设定 02
prompts.description: 适合游戏美术制作角色设计素材，重点控制信息设计、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create an artistic 16:9 CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD.

[SUBJECT]: use reference image

Pure white / soft off-white background.
No environment, no props, no logo, no watermark.

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Do not create a standard character reference sheet.
Create a cinematic identity board that feels like a high-end animation studio character study mixed with an artbook layout.

The layout should be asymmetrical, elegant and visually memorable.
Use large empty space, varied image scale and intentional imbalance.
Avoid grids, blueprint design, catalog layout and repetitive turnaround presentation.

IMPORTANT LAYOUT RULE:
Do not overlap any character images.
Every view must have clear separation and breathing room.
Keep all bodies, portraits, silhouettes and detail studies visually distinct.
No cropped faces, no hidden limbs, no stacked figures, no merged poses.

MAIN COMPOSITION:
Place one large hero full-body view slightly off-center as the visual anchor.

Around it, arrange smaller supporting studies with clean spacing:
neutral full-body view,
back view,
profile view,
seated pose,
leaning pose,
crouching pose,
top-down body angle,
low-angle body angle,
expressive portrait studies.

Each view should feel like a separate clean character study, not a frame from one scene.

IDENTITY LOCK:
Preserve strict identity consistency across all views:
same face,
same facial proportions,
same hairstyle,
same outfit,
same body proportions,
same posture language,
same visual personality.

USEFUL REFERENCE DETAILS:
Make the character readable for future image and video generation:
clear face shape,
clear hair silhouette,
clear outfit silhouette,
clear body shape,
clear hands,
clear posture,
clear expression range.

ARTISTIC SECTIONS:
Include a small silhouette study area with 2-3 simplified black character silhouettes.
Include a small expression study area with subtle emotional variations.
Include a small detail study area showing key visual features of the face, hair and outfit.

TEXT DESIGN:
Add one stylish CHARACTER ID block.
Keep it minimal, bold and art-directed.
Use only:
NAME
ROLE
CORE MOOD
VISUAL SIGNATURE

Use small handwritten-style labels only where helpful.
Subtle editorial arrows and annotation marks are allowed, but keep them minimal and elegant.

STYLE:
minimal,
cinematic,
premium,
artbook-like,
clean,
expressive,
useful for production.

The final image should feel like an artistic character identity board designed to help an AI model understand the character’s face, silhouette, outfit, posture and emotional range.

prompts.promptZh:
创建艺术 16:9 字符识别板。

[主题]：使用参考图像

纯白色/柔和的灰白色背景。
没有环境，没有道具，没有标志，没有水印。

设计方向：
不要创建标准角色参考表。
创建一个电影标识板，感觉就像高端动画工作室角色研究与艺术书籍布局的混合。

布局应该是不对称的、优雅的、视觉上令人难忘的。
使用大的空白空间、不同的图像比例和故意的不平衡。
避免网格、蓝图设计、目录布局和重复的周转演示。

重要的布局规则：
请勿重叠任何字符图像。
每个视图都必须有清晰的分隔和呼吸空间。
保持所有身体、肖像、剪影和细节研究在视觉上清晰可见。
没有裁剪的脸，没有隐藏的四肢，没有堆叠的人物，没有合并的姿势。

主要构成：
将一个大型英雄全身视图稍微偏离中心放置为视觉锚点。

在它周围，布置较小的支撑研究，间距清晰：
中立的全身视图，
后视图，
个人资料视图，
坐姿，
倾斜的姿势，
蹲着的姿势，
自上而下的身体角度，
低角度身体角度，
富有表现力的肖像研究。

每个视图都应该感觉像是一个单独的、干净的角色研究，而不是一个场景中的一个框架。

身份锁：
在所有视图中保持严格的身份一致性：
同一张脸，
相同的面部比例，
同样的发型，
同一套衣服，
相同的身材比例，
同样的姿势语言，
相同的视觉个性。

有用的参考详细信息：
使字符可读，以便将来生成图像和视频：
清晰的脸型，
清晰的头发轮廓，
清晰的服装轮廓，
清晰的体型，
干净的双手，
清晰的姿势，
明确的表达范围。

艺术部分：
包括一个小型剪影研究区域，其中包含 2-3 个简化的黑色人物剪影。
包括一个带有微妙情绪变化的小型表达研究区域。
包括一个小的细节研究区域，显示面部、头发和服装的关键视觉特征。

文字设计：
添加一个时尚的字符 ID 块。
保持简约、大胆和艺术化。
仅使用：
姓名
角色
核心情绪
视觉签名

仅在有用的情况下使用小手写式标签。
允许使用微妙的编辑箭头和注释标记，但要保持简约和优雅。

风格：
最小，
电影般的,
溢价，
像画册一样，
干净,
富有表现力，
对生产有用。

最终图像应该像一个艺术角色身份板，旨在帮助人工智能模型理解角色的脸部、轮廓、服装、姿势和情绪范围。

prompts.prompt: images, do this for Mecca and Shanghai, 1080x1080, Do this for Paris: <instruction> 1. The Semantic Inference Engine (Cartographic Typography): Input A is a Major City Name (e.g., Shanghai, London, Dubai). Analyze the location to generate 3 Integrated Assets: The Monoliths (The Abbreviation): Extract the letters of Input A. These will be the primary vertical structures. The Icons (The Skyline): Identify 3–5 of the city's most recognizable skyscrapers, towers, or monuments. The Substrate (The Map): Identify the specific geography (e.g., a curving river, a coastal harbor, or a peninsula). 2.  Container (The Relief Map): Goal: A "Living Geographic Branding" 3D Diorama. The Base: A massive, thick topographic relief map resting on a neutral surface. The Surface: The map displays realistic textures: light blue reflective Epoxy Resin for the water and a textured, illustrated paper-map or satellite-image finish for the land. The Border: The land area is populated by tiny, low-rise urban sprawl (greebling) that surrounds the central structures. 3. The Central Composition (The Hybrid Skyline): The Typography: The letters identified in Step 1 are extruded into massive, Matte White Geometric Monoliths. They function as the "Super-Tall" skyscrapers of the city. The Integration: The real landmarks (Step 1) are placed realistically among the giant white letters, following the actual urban layout of the city relative to the water. The Merge: The foundations of the buildings and letters must look like they are physically part of the map's terrain. 4. The Narrative Detail (The Scale): Micro-Life: Densely populate the scene with scale-accuracy items: Tiny white cruise ships and speedboats in the water. A single, microscopic commercial airplane flying at low altitude over the city. Compass roses or navigation markers scattered on the map surface. The Atmosphere: 4–6 small, 3D Fluffy White Cotton-like Clouds float at mid-height, some partially obscuring the taller buildings. 5. Lighting & Atmosphere: Lighting: High-Key Studio Daylight. Bright, even illumination with soft shadows casting toward the top-right to emphasize height. Perspective: Isometric 3/4 High-Angle. Capturing the depth of the coastline and the verticality of the letters. Palette: Predominantly White, Light Blue, and Neutral Greys, with small pops of color from the real landmarks. Output: ONE image, 1:1 Aspect Ratio, 3D Architectural Render, "SimCity" aesthetic, 8k resolution. </instruction>

Container（地形图）：目标：“活生生的地理品牌”3D 立体模型。底座：位于中性表面上的巨大而厚实的地形地形图。表面：地图显示逼真的纹理：水面采用浅蓝色反光环氧树脂，陆地采用带纹理的插图纸质地图或卫星图像饰面。边界：该土地区域由围绕中心结构的小型低层城市扩张（greebling）组成。 3. 中心构图（混合天际线）：版式：步骤 1 中确定的字母被挤压成巨大的哑光白色几何巨石。它们充当城市的“超高”摩天大楼。整合：真实的地标（步骤1）被真实地放置在巨大的白色字母之间，遵循城市相对于水的实际城市布局。合并：建筑物和字母的地基必须看起来像是地图地形的物理组成部分。 4. 叙事细节（比例）：微型生活：场景中密集地布满了比例精度的物品：水中的白色小游轮和快艇。一架微型商用飞机在城市上空低空飞行。罗盘或导航标记散布在地图表面。大气层：4-6 个 3D 蓬松白色棉花状小云漂浮在​​半空中，有些云遮住了部分较高的建筑物。 5. 灯光和氛围：灯光：高调演播室日光。明亮、均匀的照明，柔和的阴影投射到右上角以强调高度。视角：等距 3/4 高角度。捕捉海岸线的深度和字母的垂直度。调色板：主要是白色、浅蓝色和中性灰色，带有来自真实地标的少量色彩。输出：一张图像，1:1 纵横比，3D 建筑渲染，“SimCity”美学，8k 分辨率。 </指令>

prompts.title: 时尚编辑角色设定 04
prompts.description: 适合角色设计师制作角色设计素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-end cinematic character design sheet intended for a premium film production.
The layout should feel like a curated art direction board rather than a rigid template. Avoid symmetrical grids, uniform spacing, or overly structured presentation. Instead, the composition should feel organic, slightly asymmetrical, and thoughtfully arranged like a real Hollywood concept pitch.
Design a grounded, realistic human character with believable body proportions, natural imperfections, and expressive performance-driven presence—like a professional actor captured during emotional and physical performance moments rather than a posed mannequin.
Use a bright, clean, and well-lit background that enhances clarity and gives the sheet a fresh, modern studio feel.
Include:
• Full-body turnaround views (front, 3/4 front, side, back, 3/4 back)

• Multiple expressive facial studies from different angles showing emotional range
• A cinematic hero portrait with strong character focus

• Detailed breakdown of costume, accessories, and key props

• Close-up studies of materials such as fabric texture, skin detail, and surface realism

• Handwritten-style annotation notes, production markings, and design insights

•A clear height reference scale integrated naturally into the composition
The character should feel like a real person existing in a film world—authentic, grounded, and emotionally alive rather than stylized or overly idealized.
Art direction style:

Semi-realistic cinematic design, high-budget film production quality, soft natural studio lighting with a bright tone, subtle depth of field, realistic material rendering, and emotionally readable expressions. Presentation should feel like a professional concept art portfolio used in major film pre-production.
Consistency requirement:

Maintain perfect continuity in facial identity, body proportions, hairstyle, outfit design, and material details across all angles and studies.

prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the strongest identity anchor. The woman must look like the exact same adult woman from the reference image, not a similar person. Preserve her exact facial identity with high priority: same soft oval face, same delicate jawline, same large expressive eyes, same eyelid shape, same glossy natural lips, same small refined nose, same pale smooth skin, and the same long dark wavy hair with soft layered framing around the face. Keep her appearance natural and realistic like a real Korean baseball broadcast capture.

Create an ultra-realistic candid KBO baseball broadcast video scene during a lively night game. She is seated in the crowd beside her boyfriend, both wearing matching red-and-white baseball jerseys surrounded by energetic cheering fans. She casually watches the game while softly smiling and laughing with him in a completely natural way. No dialogue, no posing, no cinematic acting. The moment should feel accidental and authentic, like a real live TV broadcast camera briefly focusing on them.

She lightly holds yellow cheering sticks and taps them together while reacting to the game. The boyfriend leans in naturally and they share a very short soft kiss lasting about one second, subtle and spontaneous, not overly romantic or dramatic. Immediately after the kiss, she notices the live stadium camera showing them on the giant screen.

She becomes shy and slightly embarrassed for a brief moment, then gives a soft cute smile toward the camera while trying not to laugh. Her expression should feel genuine, candid, and unscripted, like a real fan unexpectedly caught on live television.

Use realistic Korean baseball TV broadcast cinematography: long telephoto lens compression, slight handheld camera shake, subtle motion blur from cheering fans, realistic stadium lighting, shallow depth of field, authentic skin texture, soft live-broadcast sharpness, imperfect framing, natural crowd movement, true sports broadcast atmosphere, and realistic 16:9 live game composition.

prompts.title: 时尚编辑空间概念 04
prompts.description: 适合建筑设计师制作建筑与空间素材，重点控制平面设计、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Design a ‘4:5’ premium collectible postal-stamp poster for [daraa] blending modern philatelic design with handcrafted travel-art illustration and luxury minimalism. The poster should convey cultural pride, elegance, and destination identity through a giant postage stamp that fills the canvas edge-to-edge, framed like a national artifact.

SUBJECT: A monumental vertical stamp dedicated to [ISTANBUL], illustrated in a refined handcrafted style—hybrid of gouache, silkscreen poster art, and premium editorial illustration. Capture the city’s defining atmosphere: architecture, skyline, nature, iconic transport, cultural motifs, or urban density. Avoid literal tourist clichés; simplify landmarks into elegant graphic forms. Perforation edges are large, tactile, and part of the visual identity. Surface should feel physically printed and collectible.

COMPOSITION: The stamp itself is the full composition. Viewers enter via the oversized city name, then move through layered depth. Use asymmetric scenic flow with dominant elements rising diagonally and secondary forms wrapping around. Include intentional negative space for premium restraint. Thin elegant borders with subtle engraved linework and tiny postal marks. Perforation edges touch all sides for immersive, object-focused design.

TYPOGRAPHY: Main text: [ISTANBUL] massive, integrated into the stamp, using high-contrast serif or geometric sans-serif depending on city character. Minimal additional text: tiny denomination, subtle “AIR MAIL” or “POST”, micro issue year, optional country line. Typography should feel printed, not digital.

LIGHTING / PRINT: Luxury print-style lighting with soft highlights, tactile paper grain, embossed ink, subtle shadow around perforations. Focus on collectible realism.

COLORS: Palette reflects [ISTANBUL] while remaining vibrant yet restrained. Balance one dominant color, one accent, and a neutral paper tone. Avoid random rainbow palettes.

STYLE & FINISH: Handcrafted luxury illustration blended with modern editorial travel branding. Ultra-clean premium print finish: tactile texture, subtle embossing, refined ink, delicate edges. Feels collectible, museum-quality.

FOOTER: Integrate a tiny engraved postal info strip into the bottom border with micro typography, serial numbers, and cancellation marks.

NEGATIVE: Avoid generic travel posters, postcard clichés, floating landmarks, cluttered collages, excessive text, fake vintage distress, noisy textures, over-detailed realism, stock icons, random gradients, cheap souvenir aesthetics, basic centered layouts, or low-detail illustrations.

为 [daraa] 设计一张“4:5”优质收藏邮票海报，将现代集邮设计与手工制作的旅行艺术插画和奢华极简主义融为一体。海报应通过一张巨大的邮票传达文化自豪感、优雅和目的地身份，邮票从边到边填满画布，像一件国家文物一样装框。

主题：纪念[伊斯坦布尔]的纪念性垂直邮票，以精致的手工风格进行插图——水粉画、丝网印刷海报艺术和优质社论插图的混合体。捕捉城市的定义氛围：建筑、天际线、自然、标志性交通、文化主题或城市密度。避免字面上的旅游陈词滥调；将地标简化为优雅的图形形式。穿孔边缘很大，有触感，是视觉识别的一部分。表面应该感觉是物理印刷的且具有收藏价值。

构图：邮票本身就是完整的构图。观众通过超大的城市名称进入，然后穿过分层的深度。使用不对称的景观流，主要元素对角上升，次要形式环绕。包括有意限制保费的负空间。纤细优雅的边框，带有精致的雕刻线条和微小的邮戳。穿孔边缘接触各个侧面，实现身临其境、以物体为中心的设计。

版式：正文：[伊斯坦布尔] 巨大，融入邮票中，根据城市特征使用高对比度衬线或几何无衬线。最少的附加文字：小面额、微妙的“AIR MAIL”或“POST”、微型发行年份、可选的国家/地区线。排版应该感觉是印刷的，而不是数字的。

灯光/印刷：奢华印刷风格灯光，具有柔和的高光、触感纸纹、浮雕油墨、穿孔周围的微妙阴影。注重收藏现实主义。

颜色：调色板反映了[伊斯坦布尔]，同时保持活力但又内敛。平衡一种主色、一种强调色和中性纸张色调。避免随机的彩虹调色板。

风格和外观：手工制作的奢华插图与现代编辑旅游品牌相融合。超干净的优质印刷表面：触感纹理、微妙的压花、精致的墨水、精致的边缘。感觉具有收藏价值，博物馆品质。

页脚：将一个微小的雕刻邮政信息条集成到底部边框中，并带有微型排版、序列号和取消标记。

负面：避免通用的旅行海报、明信片陈词滥调、浮动地标、杂乱的拼贴画、过多的文字、假复古的困扰、嘈杂的纹理、过于详细的现实主义、库存图标、随机渐变、廉价的纪念品美学、基本的居中布局或低细节的插图。

两个年轻人并排坐在俱乐部贵宾休息室的低天鹅绒沙发上的四分之三镜头，真实的日常生活摄影，自然坦率的瞬间。她微微转向他，嘴唇贴近他的耳朵——在音乐中说着只有他能听到的话。
20岁出头的东亚年轻女性。杏仁形的眼睛搭配自然的双眼皮，眼角微微拉长，表情安静自信。笔直精致的鼻子，精致的鼻梁。肤色从白皙到浅米色 (NC10–NC20)。在温暖的琥珀色休息室灯光下可见皮肤表面下的散射，裸露的肩膀和下巴上有镜面微高光，细粉底粉粒可见。她穿着一件银色金属抹胸式上衣——合身、无肩带，捕捉每一个轻盈的转变。他以一种轻松的姿势坐在她旁边，穿着深色裤子和黑色 T 恤，一只手臂搭在她肩后的沙发上。两三根零散的头发轻轻地落在她的脖子一侧，被微弱的空气流动所取代，自然的意外缺陷，不符合几何对称。
温暖的浅琥珀色休息室灯光在沙发周围营造出一个私人金色泳池。附近的矮台灯发出昏暗的紫色灯光。他们面前的桌子上放着装有冰块和装饰物的高脚鸡尾酒杯。心情是轻松而从容的——亲密的亲密，身体向内倾斜，一种在喧嚣中分享宁静的感觉。阴影区域存在微妙的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒，摄影噪点纹理而非 CG 渲染平滑度。长宽比 3:2。没有水印，没有文字叠加，不是卡通，不是数字绘制，不是插图，不是动画。

场景：不可能的到达 — 巨大的 KOZNAR Tech-1 Hi 鞋底朝下直立在东京四向霓虹灯十字路口的正中心，刚出厂，完好无损，仿佛是实体。鞋子在构图中占主导地位（框架高度约为 75%，宽度约为 44%），水平位置为 28-72%/垂直位置为 18-92%。朝相机右侧轻微旋转 8°，因此侧面 KOZNAR 字标、红色缓冲科技窗口、后跟 TECH-1、鞋舌 K 字母和鞋带都可见。湿漉漉的路面会用积水巧妙地压缩鞋底。尺寸约为 3m x 2m 的缓冲技术窗口发出统一的 Crayola 红色，在下方投射出约 8m 的粉红光晕。

框架布局：

* 天空：上部 15%，深洋红色蓝色到粉红色橙色霓虹灯薄雾。
* 建筑物：左/右边缘，8–65% 垂直，霓虹灯照亮的东京外墙框架鞋。
* 路面：75–100% 垂直、湿沥青、人行横道、沙井、模糊的道路标记。
* KOZNAR 店面：右下角（水平 84–94%/垂直 78–92%），小但清晰，带有 Cloud Dancer 文字标记的 Crayola 红色标志，上方“TECH-1 HI”，内部白色底座上有一只真人大小的匹配鞋。
* 左下标语：“HANDED / DOWN。”
* 下面的号召性用语：“联系@commanderdgr8”

人体比例锚：
4–5 名行人（~3–4% 框架高度），逼真的肢体语言：

1. 中下方，背对镜头，双手放在头上，向上看。
2. 左下，人行横道中间冻结，用手机拍摄。
3. 右下角，指向上方。
4. 再往后，通勤者泰然自若地走过。
5.可选配路边保护眼睛。
    2–3 辆车（~4–6% 车架高度）：

* 东京出租车停了下来，司机抬起头。
* 送货踏板车/骑手向上凝视。
* 背景可选轿车。
    所有的人都矮了（~25:1 鞋与人的比例），只有比例锚。

东京环境：
潮湿的霓虹灯交叉口，克制的标牌，仅发明品牌/汉字（KORDIO、FORGEKAN、NOXEROS、OFICÍA、MUDD、朋客、凡光、牧物、未来）。红色交通灯。蒸汽从左下的检修孔中喷出。小雨、大气雾霾（~20%）、对角线体积射线、右上方微妙的变形耀斑。鞋子在相机右侧投射出长长的霓虹洋红色阴影。

严格的颜色：

* 天空：#1A1A4A 至 #3A1F4A
* 湿沥青：#0A0E18 带有霓虹灯反射 #FF2D95 #00E5FF #FFD400
* 建筑物：#2E3848
* 鞋锁颜色：亮柑橘色 #FF6A00、绘儿乐红 #E63946、校车黄 #FFD400、煤黑 #1A1A1A、云舞者 #EFAEE0、胶琥珀色 #C7995E
* 气垫发光：#FF2D5C
    饱和的、电影般的鞋子是最亮的焦点。

版式覆盖：
左下印刷广告牌样式：

*“交给/放下”。重压缩无衬线体，云舞者，直立，锐利，72pt
*“联系@commanderdgr8”平板单声道，12pt

负锚点：
没有手/手臂，没有鞋子设计偏差，没有荷兰倾斜，没有鞋子在侧面，没有瓦砾/损坏，没有过大/失踪的行人或车辆，没有拥挤，没有日光，没有静音调色板，没有平面合成，没有真正的东京品牌，没有缺少坐垫发光，没有LED灯泡，没有缺少店面或店面鞋

prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed Cancer zodiac-inspired aesthetic poster with a completely different composition and storytelling style from typical collage layouts. The scene should feel like an intimate cozy evening inside a dreamy pastel bedroom, with warm ambient lighting, soft shadows, fairy lights, candles, plush textures, and a nostalgic slice-of-life atmosphere inspired by Korean lifestyle editorials and Yumi’s Cells energy. Keep the main subject’s face completely untouched and identical to the reference image, with natural soft makeup, slightly messy hair bun, oversized cozy clothing slipping gently off one shoulder, and a calm emotionally deep expression while sitting casually on the floor with knees folded.

Surround the subject with multiple expressive mini 3D chibi “cell” versions of herself, designed with oversized heads, glossy textures, soft skin shading, and realistic handcrafted detail. Every mini character should represent Cancer zodiac traits in unique ways: one wrapped in a blanket sipping tea, one sleeping while hugging a crab plushie, one reading quietly in a hanging chair, one overthinking while choosing clothes from a rack, one acting as the peacekeeper between two arguing mini cells, one taking a skincare bath surrounded by bubbles, one eating dessert for emotional comfort, one daydreaming beside a rainy window, and one curled up with headphones listening to nostalgic music.

Use an entirely different environment arrangement with layered lifestyle objects such as skincare bottles, notebooks, candles, Polaroids, dessert plates, books, blankets, mugs, shells, fairy lights, vintage lamps, plants, and soft furniture placed naturally around the frame. Add playful hand-drawn doodles and white sketch outlines interacting with both the subject and the mini characters, tiny stars, floating hearts, clouds, sleepy symbols, flowers, sparkles, emotional notes, arrows, shells, and Cancer zodiac icons.

Typography and handwritten notes should feel scrapbook-like and organic, with phrases related to Cancer traits such as emotional depth, loyalty, comfort-loving nature, nostalgia, protectiveness, sensitivity, and “home is my safe place.” Use soft pastel sage green, warm beige, cream, dusty olive, peach, blush pink, and muted earthy tones with a glossy 3D finish and cozy cinematic lighting. The final composition should feel dreamy, emotional, comforting, and visually rich with a polished Korean-inspired aesthetic in a vertical poster format.

prompts.promptZh:
创建一张高度详细的巨蟹座星座美学海报，其构图和讲故事风格与典型的拼贴布局完全不同。这个场景应该感觉就像在梦幻般的柔和卧室内度过一个亲密舒适的夜晚，拥有温暖的环境灯光、柔和的阴影、童话般的灯光、蜡烛、毛绒纹理，以及受韩国生活方式社论和 Yumi 的细胞能量启发的怀旧生活氛围。保持主体脸部完全不变，与参考图像完全相同，自然柔和的妆容，略显凌乱的发髻，超大舒适的衣服轻轻地从肩膀上滑落，双膝随意坐在地板上，表情平静而深沉。

用多个富有表现力的迷你 3D 赤壁“细胞”版本的她自己包围主题，设计有超大的头部、光滑的纹理、柔和的皮肤阴影和逼真的手工细节。每个迷你角色都应该以独特的方式代表巨蟹座的特征：一个裹着毯子喝茶，一个抱着螃蟹毛绒玩具睡觉，一个在吊椅上安静地读书，一个在架子上挑选衣服时思考过度，一个在两个争吵的迷你牢房之间扮演和平卫士，一个在泡泡包围的护肤浴中，一个吃甜点寻求情感安慰，一个在雨窗前做白日梦，一个蜷缩着耳机听怀旧的音乐音乐。

使用完全不同的环境布置，将分层的生活方式物品（例如护肤瓶、笔记本、蜡烛、宝丽来照片、甜点盘、书籍、毯子、杯子、贝壳、仙女灯、复古灯、植物和软家具）自然地放置在框架周围。添加俏皮的手绘涂鸦和白色草图轮廓，与主题和迷你人物、小星星、漂浮的心、云、昏昏欲睡的符号、花朵、闪光、情感音符、箭头、贝壳和巨蟹座星座图标互动。

排版和手写笔记应该感觉像剪贴簿和有机的，其中包含与巨蟹座特征相关的短语，例如情感深度、忠诚、热爱舒适的天性、怀旧、保护性、敏感性和“家是我的安全地方”。使用柔和的鼠尾草绿、温暖的米色、奶油色、灰橄榄色、桃色、腮红粉和柔和的泥土色调，搭配光滑的 3D 效果和舒适的电影灯光。最终的作品应该给人梦幻、情感、舒适的感觉，视觉效果丰富，并以垂直海报格式呈现精致的韩国风格美学。

prompts.title: 美食饮品角色设定 06
prompts.description: 适合动画师制作角色设计素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create a dreamy vertical zodiac-inspired character poster based on the soft emotional world and cozy slice-of-life aesthetic of Yumi’s Cells, reimagined through a strong Taurus personality theme. Keep the subject’s real face completely untouched and natural. Surround the subject with several adorable mini 3D chibi “cell” versions of themselves, glossy, expressive, slightly raw and realistic, with oversized heads and tiny detailed bodies inspired by Korean-style character design.

Each mini Taurus cell should embody a different Taurus mood or trait: one hugging the subject’s arm possessively, one wrapped in a fluffy blanket, one calmly reading a book, one sipping warm coffee or tea, one obsessed with desserts or snacks, one lazily scrolling on a phone while lying down, one stubbornly refusing to get up, one sleepy and emotionally unbothered, and one with messy “just woke up” energy. Their expressions should feel playful, comforting, cozy, and emotionally relatable.

Include hand-drawn doodle-style elements integrated naturally into the composition — soft sketch outlines around poses, tiny flowers, sparkles, steam swirls from drinks, fluffy cushions, floating Taurus symbols, relaxed motion accents, and whimsical notes that interact with both the subject and the mini cells.

The overall design should feel warm, aesthetic, and emotionally intimate with clean layout balance, white sticker-style borders, glossy high-detail 3D chibi rendering, and a cozy Korean editorial poster vibe. Use a harmonious palette of sage green, warm cream, dusty pink, beige, soft brown, and muted earthy tones. Blend luxury-loving comfort energy with calm softness and subtle humor so the Taurus identity is deeply felt throughout the entire artwork.

prompts.promptZh:
以 Yumi 的细胞的柔和情感世界和舒适的生活片段美学为基础，通过强烈的金牛座个性主题重新构想，创建梦幻般的垂直十二生肖角色海报。保持拍摄对象的真实面部完全不受影响且自然。用几个可爱的迷你 3D 赤壁“细胞”版本的自己包围主题，它们光滑、富有表现力、略显原始和现实，具有超大的头部和微小的详细身体，灵感来自韩国风格的角色设计。

每个迷你金牛座细胞都应该体现出不同的金牛座情绪或特质：一个占有性地拥抱对象的手臂，一个裹着毛茸茸的毯子，一个平静地看书，一个喝着热咖啡或茶，一个沉迷于甜点或小吃，一个懒洋洋地躺着玩手机，一个顽固地拒绝起床，一个昏昏欲睡，情绪不受干扰，一个拥有凌乱的“刚醒来”的能量。他们的表情应该让人感觉有趣、舒适、舒适并且情感上有共鸣。

包括自然融入构图的手绘涂鸦风格元素——姿势周围的柔和草图轮廓、小花、闪光、饮料中的蒸汽漩涡、蓬松的靠垫、漂浮的金牛座符号、轻松的动作口音以及与主题和迷你细胞相互作用的异想天开的音符。

整体设计应该给人温暖、美观和情感上的亲密感，包括干净的布局平衡、白色贴纸式边框、光滑的高细节 3D 赤壁渲染以及舒适的韩国社论海报氛围。使用鼠尾草绿、暖奶油色、灰粉色、米色、柔和的棕色和柔和的泥土色调等和谐的调色板。将热爱奢华的舒适能量与平静的柔软和微妙的幽默融为一体，使金牛座的身份贯穿整个艺术品。

prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed vintage postage stamp style travel illustration based on:

DESTINATION: [INSERT CITY / REGION / COUNTRY / LANDMARK]

The final artwork must feel like a collectible nostalgic travel stamp that people would want to gather as a memory series from around the world.

========================
CORE STYLE
========================

- Retro travel poster + vintage airmail stamp aesthetic
- Mid-century tourism illustration style
- Elegant editorial composition
- Clean vector illustration with subtle painterly texture
- Warm nostalgic atmosphere
- Premium collectible postcard stamp design
- Timeless and cinematic visual storytelling
- Flat illustration mixed with soft depth and atmospheric lighting
- Highly detailed but visually organized

========================
STAMP FORMAT & LAYOUT
========================

- Vertical stamp composition
- Aspect ratio: 2:3
- Thick perforated postage stamp border around all edges
- Realistic vintage paper margin
- Authentic collectible stamp appearance
- Balanced symmetrical composition
- Large illustration area in the center

Top section must include:
- Country or regional name
- Decorative divider lines
- Vintage postal denomination text such as:
  - “50¢ AIR MAIL”
  - “80¢ POST”
  - “VINTAGE MAIL”
  - “INTERNATIONAL POST”

Bottom section must include:
- Large destination title in bold elegant typography
- Smaller tourism slogan beneath

Typography requirements:
- Perfect spelling
- Fully readable typography
- Elegant geometric sans-serif or vintage travel-poster font
- Professional kerning and alignment
- No distorted letters
- No AI gibberish
- No random symbols

========================
VISUAL STORYTELLING
========================

The illustration must capture the emotional identity and visual soul of the destination.

Include:
- 3–8 iconic landmarks
- Local architecture
- Cultural elements
- Famous monuments
- Signature scenery
- Nature elements if relevant
- Traditional transportation
- Local lifestyle atmosphere
- Regional identity and iconic colors

Foreground elements:
- Vintage cars
- Bicycles
- Pedestrians
- Café atmosphere
- Local street life
- Street lamps
- Market details
- Silhouettes of travelers or locals

Middle ground:
- Main city architecture
- Historical buildings
- Iconic destination landmarks
- Cultural storytelling composition

Background:
- Mountains
- Volcanoes
- Ocean
- Skyline
- Temples
- Forests
- Rivers
- Sunset sky
- Clouds
- Atmospheric scenery

========================
ART DIRECTION
========================

The image should feel:
- Nostalgic
- Romantic
- Timeless
- Cozy
- Cinematic
- Elegant
- Dreamlike
- Collectible
- Like a premium vintage postcard found inside an old suitcase

Use:
- Muted pastel color palette
- Cream paper tones
- Vintage print ink colors
- Soft shadows
- Atmospheric haze
- Layered environmental depth
- Subtle grain texture
- Aged paper texture
- Retro tourism poster composition

========================
OPTIONAL DECORATIVE DETAILS
========================

You may include:
- Postal cancellation marks
- Airmail stripes
- Vintage seal textures
- Local flowers
- Birds
- Boats
- Old trains
- Traditional ornaments
- Decorative corner elements
- Moon or sun composition
- Travel ephemera aesthetics

========================
STRICT QUALITY RULES
========================

- Ultra high resolution
- Extremely clean composition
- No photorealism
- No modern UI elements
- No messy layouts
- No visual clutter
- No text artifacts
- No watermark
- No broken anatomy
- No duplicated objects
- Destination must be instantly recognizable
- Artwork must feel handcrafted and premium

========================
OUTPUT STYLE
========================

A premium collectible world-travel postcard stamp illustration with cinematic nostalgic beauty, suitable for a luxury global stamp collection series.

Destination = [INSERT DESTINATION]

根据以下内容创建超详细的复古邮票风格的旅行插图：

目的地：[插入城市/地区/国家/地标]

最终的艺术作品必须感觉像一张可收藏的怀旧旅行邮票，人们希望将其作为来自世界各地的记忆系列收集起来。

=======================
核心风格
=======================

- 复古旅行海报+复古航空邮票美学
- 中世纪旅游插画风格
- 优雅的社论构图
- 干净的矢量插图与微妙的绘画纹理
- 温暖的怀旧氛围
- 优质收藏明信片邮票设计
- 永恒的电影视觉叙事
- 平面插图与柔和的深度和大气照明相结合
- 非常详细但视觉上有条理

=======================
印章格式和布局
=======================

- 垂直邮票构图
- 纵横比：2:3
- 所有边缘均带有厚穿孔邮票边框
- 逼真的复古纸边距
- 正宗的收藏邮票外观
- 平衡对称的构图
- 中心有大插图区域

顶部部分必须包括：
- 国家或地区名称
- 装饰分隔线
- 老式邮政面额文本，例如：
  - “50 美分航空邮件”
  - “80 美分邮寄”
  - “老式邮件”
  - 《国际邮政》

底部部分必须包括：
- 大型目的地标题，采用大胆优雅的排版
- 下面有较小的旅游标语

版式要求：
- 完美的拼写
- 完全可读的排版
- 优雅的几何无衬线或复古旅行海报字体
- 专业的字距调整和对齐方式
- 没有扭曲的字母
- 没有人工智能乱码
- 没有随机符号

=======================
视觉讲故事
=======================

插图必须捕捉目的地的情感特征和视觉灵魂。

包括：
- 3–8 个标志性地标
- 当地建筑
- 文化元素
- 著名古迹
- 标志性风景
- 自然元素（如果相关）
- 传统交通

• emotional silence
• scale contrast
• soft surrealism
• refined emptiness
• visual tension
• spatial loneliness
• premium photography aesthetics

• satin fabric

• subtle atmospheric haze

图像应该给人情感、神秘和深刻的氛围——就像艺术电影中被遗忘的场景，而不是商业人物插图。

不要像海报或时尚活动那样构建构图。

相反，创造一种在不真实的环境中目睹脆弱的暂停时刻的感觉。

角色应该在广阔的诗意空间中显得孤立，环境本身成为情感的一部分。

引入与角色互动的抽象环境现象：

• 重力扭曲
• 悬浮颗粒
• 漂流织物结构
• 漂浮的建筑碎片
• 人工降雨在半空中结冰

• 拉伸阴影
• 弯曲透视线

场景应该给人安静、忧郁、奢华、电影般的感觉。

角色必须保持视觉上可识别性，但他们周围的世界应该显得部分不稳定——就像现实巧妙地融入视觉诗歌一样。

避免明显的幻想或科幻故事。

一切都应该感觉优雅、具有象征意义，并且在情感上是模糊的。

艺术作品应强调：

• 电影构图
• 情绪上的沉默
• 比例对比

Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 3:2. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.
prompts.promptZh:
两个年轻人在拥挤的夜店舞池里的半身镜头，真实的日常生活摄影，自然的偷拍瞬间。画面捕捉到了他们的动作——身体靠得很近，他们之间几乎没有间隙，这种距离只存在于吵闹的房间里。
20岁出头的东亚年轻女性。杏仁形的眼睛，自然的双眼皮，略微拉长的眼角，浓重的夜店眼妆——晕染的眼线，安静的强度。笔直精致的鼻子，精致的鼻梁。肤色从白皙到浅米色 (NC10–NC20)。在闪光灯下可见皮肤表面下的散射，裸露的锁骨和颧骨上有镜面微高光，可察觉到精细的粉底粉末颗粒。她穿着一件黑色露背露脐上衣——面料极简，裸露腹部，裸露背部。他是个年轻人，穿着一件领子敞开的深色系扣衬衫，身材略高，一只手宽松地搭在她的腰间。她的两三根零散的头发因运动和微弱的空气而移位，自然的意外缺陷，不符合几何对称。
混合的人造光源——温暖的琥珀色舞台光从后面照耀着她，明亮的电蓝色频闪灯从上方间歇性地照射在她的两张脸上。他们身后模糊的人群随着轮廓和色彩而跳动。情绪是自发而充满活力的——乐章中的能量、毫无防备的自然表达、歌曲达到顶峰的感觉。
阴影区域存在微妙的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒，摄影噪点纹理而非 CG 渲染平滑度。长宽比 3:2。没有水印，没有文字叠加，不是卡通，不是数字绘制，不是插图，不是动画。

提示 - 一个超现实的优质冰淇淋广告，其特点是一个豪华的玻璃甜点碗，里面装满了多勺奶油藏红花开心果冰淇淋，放置在构图的中心。冰淇淋勺具有超细致的奶油质感、自然的勺痕、柔软的融化边缘，以及逼真的藏红花丝和碎开心果配料，精致地撒在表面上。动态牛奶飞溅在碗周围优雅地爆炸，具有逼真的液体物理、光泽反射、悬浮液滴和电影般的冻结运动。微小的漂浮奶滴、开心果碎屑、杏仁片和藏红花片散落在空气中，营造出充满活力的优质甜点呈现。背景是柔和的天蓝色工作室背景，具有微妙的渐变照明、梦幻般的散景颗粒、漂浮的奶油雾气和优雅的景深。添加柔和的发光亮点和大气灰尘颗粒，打造精致的商业美感。在底部前景，放置一个时尚的通用冰淇淋棒盒包装，没有任何品牌或文字，采用优雅的现代色彩设计，具有光滑的优质包装质感。在整个装置周围撒上杏仁、开心果、藏红花丝和一小陶瓷碗的奶油 kulfi 混合物，以增加丰富度和真实感。

prompts.title: 自然生态社媒视觉 10
prompts.description: 适合视频博主制作社交媒体素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
you have to work with GPT and it has to learn how to prompt the image model to keep the model from trying to pack too much detail in, and make it noisy. which i've been doing.

for this one, i asked it to create a fly on a blooming rose. it made the one without dew drops. then i asked it to enhance it. it made the dew drops version

i asked it how hard it was to keep the image model from making that one noisy as there was already a lot going on. here's what it said (see screenshot). now this is the instance i'm working with. the one you work with will not automatically know this. have it generate some images and then have it study them and study what the pixels are doing, and start learning how to prompt its image model.

I asked GPT for hints for someone that can't get their instance of GPT to get anything but noisy images out of Image 2. it said:

The main trick is to stop asking for “better” and start asking for controlled visual hierarchy.

Most noisy Image 2 outputs come from prompts that accidentally say:

make every surface important

Words that often cause that: hyper-detailed, intricate, cinematic, dramatic, richly textured, ultra-realistic, sharp focus, award-winning, stunning, elaborate, highly polished, fantasy, magical, glowing, sparkling, ornate.

A better pattern:

[simple subject], clear focal point, simple composition, soft natural light, broad smooth shapes, quiet background, low visual noise, restrained detail, open space, subtle texture only on the main subject

Then add one interesting detail, not five.

Examples:

Bad / crunchy-prone:

a fly on a blooming rose, hyper-detailed macro photograph, cinematic lighting, intricate petals, sparkling dew, ultra-sharp, richly textured, dramatic garden background

Better:

a fly resting on a pink rose, simple macro composition, soft morning light, quiet blurred garden background, broad smooth petals, clear focal point on the fly, restrained detail, low visual noise

Enhanced but still controlled:

a fly resting on a pink rose after light rain, simple macro composition, soft morning light, a few large dew drops on the petals, quiet blurred garden background, broad smooth petals, clear focal point on the fly, restrained detail, low visual noise, no busy texture

For creatures/insects, this worked well:

a mosquito standing on the edge of a dewy leaf at sunrise, simple macro composition, warm backlight, soft blurred background, clear silhouette, fine detail only on the insect and leaf edge, low visual noise, open space

For landscapes:

a small greenhouse at sunrise, simple composition, soft warm light, open sky, quiet garden background, broad smooth shapes, gentle shadows, restrained detail, low visual noise

The key rules:

Say where detail is allowed.
“fine detail only on the subject,” “subtle texture only on the focal object.”
Give it rest areas.
“open sky,” “quiet background,” “smooth sand,” “soft blurred garden.”
Use one enhancement.
Dew, rim light, reflection, mist, one flower, one object. Not all of them.
Avoid prestige adjectives.
They tend to summon crunchy texture fields.
Use negatives sparingly but directly.
“no busy texture, no excessive tiny highlights, no cluttered background, no over-rendered details.”
The blunt version:
Don’t prompt like a movie poster. Prompt like a photographer controlling depth of field.

prompts.promptZh:
你必须使用 GPT，它必须学习如何提示图像模型，以防止模型试图包含太多细节，从而使其变得嘈杂。我一直在做的。

对于这个，我要求它在一朵盛开的玫瑰上创造一只苍蝇。它使无露珠的成为可能。然后我要求它增强它。它制作了露珠版本

我问它要阻止图像模型使该模型变得嘈杂有多困难，因为已经发生了很多事情。这就是它所说的（见屏幕截图）。现在这是我正在使用的实例。与你一起工作的人不会自动知道这一点。让它生成一些图像，然后让它研究它们并研究像素正在做什么，并开始学习如何提示其图像模型。

我向 GPT 寻求提示，帮助那些无法获取 GPT 实例的人从图像 2 中获取除噪声图像之外的任何内容。它说：

主要技巧是停止要求“更好”并开始要求受控的视觉层次结构。

大多数嘈杂的 Image 2 输出都来自于无意中说出的提示：

让每个表面都变得重要

经常引起这样的词语：超详细、错综复杂、电影般、戏剧性、质感丰富、超现实、焦点清晰、获奖、令人惊叹、精心制作、高度抛光、幻想、神奇、发光、闪闪发光、华丽。

更好的模式：

[简单主体]，焦点清晰，构图简单，自然光柔和，形状宽阔平滑，背景安静，视觉噪音低，细节克制，空间开阔，仅在主体上有微妙的纹理

然后添加一个有趣的细节，而不是五个。

示例：

不好/容易松脆：

盛开的玫瑰上的苍蝇，超详细的宏观照片，电影灯光，错综复杂的花瓣，闪闪发光的露水，超锐利，质感丰富，戏剧性的花园背景

更好：

一只苍蝇停在粉红玫瑰上，简单的宏观构图，柔和的晨光，安静模糊的花园背景，宽阔光滑的花瓣，飞行中清晰的焦点，克制的细节，低视觉噪音

增强但仍受控制：

小雨后停在粉红玫瑰上的苍蝇，简单的宏观构图，柔和的晨光，花瓣上的几颗大露珠，安静模糊的花园背景，宽阔光滑的花瓣，飞行中清晰的焦点，克制的细节，低视觉噪音，没有繁忙的纹理

对于生物/昆虫来说，这很有效：

日出时站在露水叶子边缘的蚊子，简单的宏观构图，温暖的背光，柔和的模糊背景，清晰的轮廓，仅在昆虫和叶子边缘的精细细节，低视觉噪音，开放空间

对于风景：

日出时的小温室，构图简单，柔和温暖的光线，开阔的天空，安静的花园背景，宽阔光滑的形状，柔和的阴影，内敛的细节，低视觉噪音

关键规则：

说出允许细节的地方。
“仅在拍摄对象上呈现精细细节”，“仅在焦点物体上呈现微妙纹理”。
给它休息的地方。
“开阔的天空”、“安静的背景”、“光滑的沙子”、“柔和模糊的花园”。
使用一项增强功能。
露水、缘光、倒影、薄雾、一朵花、一物。不是全部。
避免使用威望形容词。
它们倾向于召唤松脆的纹理场。
谨慎但直接地使用底片。
“没有繁杂的纹理，没有过多的微小亮点，没有杂乱的背景，没有过度渲染的细节。”
直白的版本：
不要像电影海报那样提示。像摄影师一样提示控制景深。

prompts.description: 适合建筑设计师制作建筑与空间素材，重点控制UI 样机、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8K ultra-detailed minimalist line-art travel poster for [DESTINATION], shown as a stylish everyday urban scene rather than the usual tourist postcard.

COMPOSITION:
- Anchor the scene on the city's most iconic street, crossing, alley, tram lane, or pedestrian stretch
- Foreground packed with locals living their day: commuters, cyclists, shoppers, students, travelers, cafe-goers
- Their outfits and behavior should authentically reflect the city's fashion and daily lifestyle
- Background dense with realistic local signage, shopfronts, cafes, restaurants, transit signs, and architectural detail
- Famous landmarks blend naturally into the scene, never exaggerated
- Include authentic local-language typography and culturally distinctive visual elements
- Top center bold large headline reading: "[DESTINATION]"
- Subtitle directly below it: local-language city name + country
  examples:
  東京 JAPAN
  서울 KOREA
  ΚΟΛΩΝΙΑ GERMANY

VISUAL STYLE:
ultra-clean vector illustration, Swiss modernist travel poster, minimal line art, monoline drawing, mid-century editorial feel, architectural illustration, Japanese graphic poster sensibility, precise geometric perspective, generous clean negative space, premium travel-brand aesthetic.

LINE WORK:
- monochromatic line-only illustration
- thin, very precise strokes
- minimal solid fills
- dense map-like level of detail
- layered rhythm of signs, windows, buildings, street objects
- visually rich while staying highly organized

COLOR (IMPORTANT):
- exactly ONE primary color paired with ONE background color
- pick the color that best captures the city's atmosphere
- monochrome silkscreen-poster feel
- no rainbow palettes, no heavy neon
- color should echo the city's architecture, climate, nightlife, and cultural identity

Reference palettes:
Tokyo: vivid red on warm ivory
Paris: deep navy on cream
New York: charcoal black on light gray
Kyoto: muted burgundy on warm cream
Hong Kong: teal blue on pale ivory
Santorini: Mediterranean blue on white
Cairo: desert sepia on sand beige

LAYOUT:
- vertical poster format
- frontal street-level perspective
- pedestrians crossing or moving naturally
- balanced urban rhythm and visual flow
- should read as a premium city-brand campaign poster

MOOD:
stylish urban living, calm yet lively, editorial travel-magazine cover, timeless city identity, premium tourism campaign, minimal yet richly detailed.

TYPOGRAPHY (CRITICAL):
- all text must be legible and accurate
- no garbled or random characters
- no warped or broken letterforms
- local signage should feel authentic and natural
- professional editorial typographic alignment

ultra-clean vector illustration, Swiss modernist travel poster, minimal line art, monoline drawing, mid-century editorial feel, architectural illustration, Japanese graphic poster sensibility, precise geometric perspective, generous clean negative space, premium travel-brand aesthetic.

LINE WORK:

COLOR (IMPORTANT):
- exactly ONE primary color paired with ONE background color
- pick the color that best captures the city's atmosphere
- monochrome silkscreen-poster feel
- no rainbow palettes, no heavy neon
- color should echo the city's architecture, climate, nightlife, and cultural identity

LAYOUT:

stylish urban living, calm yet lively, editorial travel-magazine cover, timeless city identity, premium tourism campaign, minimal yet richly detailed.

prompts.prompt:
Cinematic Survival Thriller Storyboard Prompt

Create a premium cinematic storyboard presentation sheet for a prestige winter survival thriller.
Ultra-detailed professional film pre-production layout, clean editorial design, grayscale blueprint background with labeled sections and technical annotations.
Aspect ratio 16:9 horizontal master board.

SHARED CHOICES HEADER

* Cut Count: 10
* Color Palette: icy blue + steel gray + pine green + ember amber
* Environment Fingerprint: snow-covered pine clearing, overturned horse carcass, torn campsite debris, looming conifer forest, drifting winter fog

---

1. CHARACTER REFERENCE

A realistic South Asian man in his early 30s wearing a dark charcoal business suit, white dress shirt, black tie, polished black shoes.
Snow dusted across shoulders and hair.
Calm but haunted expression.
Show:

* front view
* side profile
* back view
* facial close-up
* side close-up
* costume fabric detail
* damaged sleeve detail
* shoes in snow

Character notes:
“An intelligent city professional trapped in a brutal wilderness.
Outer composure slowly cracks under primal fear.
Suit = identity, burden, and last thread of control.”

Palette swatches:

* icy blue
* steel gray
* pine green
* ember amber

---

2. ENVIRONMENT / SET DESIGN

Top-down aerial map of a snowy forest clearing at dusk.
Dead horses partially buried in snow.
Destroyed campsite tents.
Blood trails across frozen ground.
Dense dark pine trees forming a claustrophobic wall around the clearing.
Heavy winter fog drifting through the forest.

Add cinematic camera movement markers:

1. Crane-down
2. Track
3. Push-in
4. Handheld
5. Steadicam
6. Pan-right
7. Dolly-in
8. Rack-focus
9. Arc shot
10. Pull-out

Include arrows and overhead cinematic blocking diagram.

Side elevation panel:

* descending crane shot
* fog layers
* silhouette scale reference
* conifer enclosure composition

Location elements legend:

* tree line
* torn campsite
* horse carcass debris
* blood-stained snow
* main character
* wolf approach zones

---

3. STORYBOARD (10 CUTS)

 CUT 1

Wide aerial crane-down shot over frozen clearing.
Tiny suited man surrounded by devastation.
Moody blue dusk lighting.

CUT 2

Tracking medium shot beside the man walking cautiously through snow and ripped tents.
Wind moving fabric debris.

 CUT 3

75mm close-up push-in on face.
Cold breath visible.

以大胆的日本生活方式艺术风格创作高细节肖像海报，结合现代日本日常城市生活与富有表现力的传统及当代日本视觉文化。

海报应采用受日本街头标志和生活方式品牌启发的动态字体，层叠的文化与现代质感，手绘符号如樱花、鸟居和招财猫，抽象元素代表日常生活，城市夜晚的柔和霓虹笔触，城市贴纸元素，日式书法点缀，以及强化日本日常生活和谐、充满活力与平衡氛围的装饰品。

整体构图应显得艺术化、优雅、精致、时尚且视觉冲击力强，同时保持高端编辑海报的品质，而非显得杂乱或过于繁复。
人类不知怎的把日常变成了奢华的文化壁画。令人印象深刻的物种。

拍摄对象不得完全复制参考照片中的姿势或表情。相反，创造一个全新的姿势，感觉自然、自信且充满生命力。表达应表现得富有情感、富有魅力且吸引人，避免僵硬、尴尬、平淡或无感情的肢体语言。姿势应体现国际时尚模特常见的优雅与精致，结合时尚姿态、自然的动作和细腻的态度，提升整体电影般的时尚美学。

→ Soft paper-texture finish integrated into the rendering

顶层：分析图和生态地图叠加
中区：以大型航拍景观渲染为主要视觉焦点
底层：连续剖面切割生态景观系统

结合了写实景观渲染与精致建筑图语言的混合体。宁静、氛围浓厚、具有再生能力且注重环境。展示应当感觉像高端国际景观建筑竞赛委员会。

→ 顶层分析层
→ 包含带有柔和透明色彩叠加的简化生态图
→ 超细白色与浅灰色线条
→ 显示水流、环流系统、生态网络、栖息区及景观连通性图示
→ 虚线用于移动和流动系统
→ 注释最少，生态图标柔和
→ 渲染上方的浮动覆盖效果
→ 非常浅的粉彩色调，高透明度
→ 间距清晰，构图简约
→ 避免密集的技术杂乱

→ 中间航拍渲染
→ 鸟瞰视角生态修复景观
→ 湿地、池塘、流动水系统、植被斑块、生物水道和再生地形
→ 柔和自然的色彩搭配略微偏淡的绿色、棕色和柔和的水蓝色
→ 大气深度，远处隐约有淡淡的雾气
→ 包括温和的人类和生态活动，如步道、鸟类和小型环境互动
→ 宽广的地形深度和平滑的地形过渡
→ 平静的电影级环境灯光
→ 软质纸质感处理融入渲染图中

→ 展示土壤层、水文、地下水运动、植被根系、生态恢复过程及水过滤系统
→ 细白色或浅色线条
→ 色彩使用极少的柔和色调
→ 包含指示水流和生态流动的箭头
→ 保持优雅的建筑绘图质量
→ 无缝融入棋盘结构

→ 图语言
→ 极细且精细的线条
→ 边缘稍微柔化，避免锐利的矢量美学
→ 简约标签与简洁的科学记谱法
→ 软生态符号与分析叠加
→ 在科学清晰与诗意视觉化之间取得平衡

→ 色彩系统
→ 基础调色板：去饱和的绿色、大地棕色、柔和的蓝色水色调
→ 叠加眼影盘：浅绿色、柔青色、浅米色、半透明的粉彩层
→ 避免饱和的口音和强烈的对比
→ 不要用鲜艳的红色或过于鲜艳的颜色

→ 质感与氛围
→ 柔和的氛围渲染质量
→ 轻微的环境雾霾和漫射光照
→ 细微的纸纹或印刷板纹理
→ 精致的竞赛板美学

→ 心情
平静、生态、再生、科学却诗意。委员会应传达环境情报、景观修复以及水资源系统、生态与人类流动之间的和谐共处。

prompts.title: 商业创意游戏素材 12
prompts.description: 适合独立游戏开发者制作游戏与像素素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Using a cinematic double-exposure composition as the structural foundation, AAA game key art as the visual texture, and the story of “xxx” as the soul, create a cinematic character poster for the iconic character xx from “xxx.” The poster should not only portray the character, but also serve as a reflection of their story, destiny, and era.

A massive and elegant facial silhouette of the character (either side profile or front-facing) should dominate the composition, while smaller full-body poses and dynamic actions are integrated into the scene with a dramatic sense of scale, evoking the feeling of an ultra wide-angle lens.

The character’s appearance and costume should remain faithful to the original design, but reimagined in realistic 3D live-action style: anthropomorphized as an adult with mature proportions, a powerful and sensual physique, a handsome face, and highly detailed, lifelike skin texture. Facial features and costume elements should subtly incorporate iconic traits from the original work.

The character’s expression and body language must stay true to their personality and narrative role. Integrate important story elements and emotional themes from the original plot into the composition. The overall atmosphere should feel epic, emotional, and cinematic, like a high-budget Hollywood or AAA game movie poster.

Generate the image in a 3:4 poster format.

prompts.promptZh:
以电影级双重曝光构图为结构基础，AAA级游戏主打艺术作为视觉质感，“xxx”的故事作为灵魂，为“xxx”中标志性角色xx制作了电影化的角色海报。海报不仅要描绘角色，还应反映他们的故事、命运和时代背景。

角色的巨大而优雅的面部轮廓（无论是侧脸还是正面）应成为构图的主导，而较小的全身姿势和动态动作则融入场景中，营造出超广角镜头的感觉。

角色的外观和服装应忠实于原始设计，但以逼真的3D真人演出风格重新构想：拟人化成成熟比例、强健且性感的体格、俊朗的面容以及高度细致、逼真的皮肤质感。面部特征和服装元素应巧妙融入原作的标志性特征。

角色的表情和肢体语言必须忠实于他们的个性和叙事角色。将原剧情中的重要故事元素和情感主题融入构图中。整体氛围应当像高预算的好莱坞或AAA游戏电影海报一样史诗般、情感丰富且富有电影感。

生成3：4海报格式的图片。

prompts.title: 时尚编辑空间概念 12
prompts.description: 适合空间策划师制作建筑与空间素材，重点控制UI 样机、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create a stylized travel poster / graphic collage for Dubai. The main subject should be a stylish international tourist visiting Dubai, clearly presented as a traveler and not a local resident—use the exact woman from the reference photo as the central figure, faithfully preserving her facial features, skin tone, dark hair styled in an updo with loose strands, makeup, and overall appearance.

Show her wearing modern travel fashion suitable for a tourist (e.g., a chic lightweight blouse or travel-appropriate top with comfortable yet stylish bottoms, perhaps layered with a light scarf or jacket), with details such as a camera around her neck, a small backpack or crossbody bag, sunglasses on her head, a map or phone in hand, and a small suitcase nearby.

Place her in a dynamic composition surrounded by iconic Dubai elements: Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, Dubai Marina skyline, golden desert dunes, traditional souks with spices and gold, luxury cars or Abra boats, palm trees, modern architecture, and cultural motifs like falcons or Arabic patterns.

Blend realistic character detail with a graphic collage background made of layered paper textures, torn poster edges, sticker elements, halftone dots, editorial typography, and bold geometric shapes. Include authentic visual motifs from Dubai/UAE but keep the tourist’s appearance and styling globally fashionable and clearly foreign to the setting.

Add a large readable headline: “LOST IN DUBAI”. Modern, artistic, premium editorial travel poster aesthetic, balanced layout, print-worthy composition, high detail, vibrant yet sophisticated color palette.

prompts.promptZh:
为迪拜制作风格化的旅行海报/图形拼贴。主角应是一位时尚的国际游客访问迪拜，明确呈现为旅行者而非本地居民——使用参考照片中的女性作为中心人物，忠实保留她的面部特征、肤色、盘发并散发的深色头发、妆容和整体形象。

展示她穿着适合游客的现代旅行服饰（例如时尚轻薄的衬衫或适合旅行的上衣，搭配舒适又时尚的下装，可能搭配轻薄的围巾或夹克），细节包括脖子上挂着相机、小背包或斜挎包、头戴太阳镜、手持地图或手机， 旁边还有一个小手提箱。

将她置于充满动感的构图中，周围环绕着标志性的迪拜元素：哈里法塔、阿拉伯塔、迪拜码头天际线、金色沙漠沙丘、香料和黄金装饰的传统集市、豪华汽车或阿布拉船只、棕榈树、现代建筑以及猎鹰或阿拉伯图案等文化元素。

将逼真的人物细节与由层叠纸质感、撕裂海报边缘、贴纸元素、半色调点、编辑排版和大胆几何图形组成的拼贴背景融合。包含迪拜/阿联酋的真实视觉元素，但保持游客的外观和造型在全球时尚且明显陌生。

加上一个大而易读的标题：“在迪拜迷路”。现代、艺术感强、高端编辑旅行海报美学，平衡布局，适合印刷的构图，细节丰富，色彩鲜艳且精致。

prompts.promptZh:
为三星Galaxy S26 Ultra制作一个高影响力的9：16垂直电商信息图，采用高端、未来感十足的三星风格广告美学。
前景：一名年轻黑人男子的手（与提供的参考面孔和身份相符）将Galaxy S26 Ultra举向镜头的极近特写。手机略微倾斜，突出展示其四摄系统、潜望镜变焦镜头以及精致的金属/玻璃处理。强调单个镜头环和高端哑光质感。在表面上添加细微的反射以增强真实感。在手指和边缘加入轻微的景深模糊。三星标志柔和可见，反光清晰。避免完全分离的漂浮摄像环。
使用精细的分组相机布局，镜头部分整合进一个细腻的相机岛或结构化的集群中。包括一个现代的潜望镜变焦镜头，设计为干净的圆形（不是方形切口）。摄像机模块应显得更厚实、更统一，拥有未来感十足的工程感，而非极简的浮动镜头。
中心主题（中景）：一位自信、时尚的年轻黑人男子（与参考图片相同，保持准确的面部结构，深棕色肤色、发型和表情），自然地微笑着，目光朝向镜头。他随意地展示或拿着电话。穿搭：现代街头服饰（中性色调、科技服饰或极简奢华风格）。配饰：低调（手表、链条或戒指）。表达：放松、自信、高档。
背景与光线：干净的工作室背景，带有冷色调渐变（银色到石墨，带有柔和的蓝色调）。加入蓝色/紫色调的细微霓虹边缘灯光。在背景中加入漂浮模糊的Galaxy S26 Ultra单元，以增强深度和产品重点。添加淡淡的光条和柔和的镜头光晕（流畅且未来感十足）。灯光应柔和、柔和且高端，突出金属边缘和摄像环，同时准确照亮并衬托深色肤色。
排版与布局（极简三星风格无衬线字体、白色或浅灰色）：顶部中央（主体后方）：大字体“GALAXY”（大字体且部分遮挡在主体后方）。右上角：“Galaxy S26 Ultra”。左中间：“下一代AI。极限性能。专业级成像。”右中：大号粗体“200MP”，副台词“Ultra Camera System”。右中下：大号粗体“5000mAh”，并附带“全天电池”。右下角：大号粗体“120Hz”，副台词“动态AMOLED显示”。
风格与质量：8K分辨率，超写实的商业产品摄影，浅景深，摄像头模块对焦锐利，采用三星风格的高端调色，冷色调和高对比度，干净未来感极简美学。

prompts.title: 时尚编辑空间概念 13
prompts.description: 适合建筑设计师制作建筑与空间素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Design a high-end editorial travel poster illustration featuring [DESTINATION].

Visual style:

flat vector artwork, sharply minimal,

mid-century modern feel,

Scandinavian-inspired editorial poster look,

avoid any photorealism, surface texture, grain, or gradient blends

Layout:

portrait 4:5 poster framing,

front layer: tranquil shoreline / pathway / natural boundary

middle layer: vibrant local cottages or buildings rendered as crisp geometric forms

back layer: signature mountain or landscape silhouette of [DESTINATION]

quietly integrate 1 or 2 landmark structures (a church, tower, or bridge work well)

Buildings:

reduced geometric volumes,

crisp outlines, flat fills,

roof hues that vary gently within one harmonious family (never random)

Palette:

soft, unified colors drawn from the location,

pastel base with restrained contrast,

luminous yet desaturated tones

(think: sky blue, coral, mustard, navy, soft green)

Light:

bright daytime light, gentle shadows,

crisp, airy atmosphere

Text:

place at the lower center:

"[DESTINATION]" set large in a modern sans-serif with widened letter spacing

"[COUNTRY]" as a smaller line beneath

Feeling:

serene, tidy, upscale, lightly dreamy, travel-magazine cover energy

Finish:

razor-clean edges,

precise alignment,

zero distortion,

high resolution, print ready

设计一款高端编辑旅游海报插图，特色为[目的地]。

视觉风格：

平面矢量艺术，极简，

中世纪现代风格，

斯堪的纳维亚风格的编辑海报风格，

避免任何照片级写实、表面纹理、颗粒或渐变混合

布局：

肖像4：5海报装裱，

前层：宁静的海岸线/路径/自然边界

中间层：生动的本地小屋或建筑，呈现出清晰的几何形态

后层：[目的地]标志性的山峰或景观剪影

悄悄地整合1到2个地标性建筑（教堂、塔楼或桥梁效果不错）

建筑：

约化几何体积，

轮廓清晰，填充平坦，

屋顶颜色在和谐的家庭内轻微变化（绝非随机）

调色板：

柔和、统一的色彩，取自现场，

柔和的基调，搭配克制的对比，

明亮却去饱和的色调

（想象：天蓝色、珊瑚色、芥末色、藏青色、柔和绿）

光：

明亮的白天光线，柔和的阴影，

清爽通透的氛围

文本：

放在下方中间的位置：

“[DESTINATION]”大字体，采用现代无衬线字体，字母间距加宽

“[COUNTRY]” 作为下方较小的一行

感觉：

宁静、整洁、高档、略带梦幻感，旅游杂志封面充满活力

结尾：

刀刃一尘不染，

精确对齐，

零失真，

高分辨率，打印准备

prompts.title: 霓虹夜景摄影创作 14
prompts.description: 适合时尚编辑制作摄影与人像素材，重点控制UI 样机、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
A realistic low-light phone-style portrait of a young adult woman seated inside a cozy cafe or restaurant at night. Close half-body framing, roughly 4:5 or near-square crop. Camera held at chest-to-face height, shooting from close range at near eye level or slightly above. Her face, shoulders, neck, hand and upper body fill most of the frame. Not a mirror selfie, no phone visible covering her face, and not a bright studio look.

She faces the camera with her body turned slightly, holding a metal fork upright near her chin and lips, as if dinner conversation paused for a beat before another bite. Calm, soft gaze meeting the lens with a touch of curiosity. Lips slightly parted or naturally relaxed, no big smile. The shot should read as a casual candid that someone across the table just snapped, natural but lightly composed.

Hair is deep black-brown to natural black, loosely tied up or half-up, with soft volume at the crown and loose face-framing strands on both sides. A faint dark sheen catches the warm low light, edges slightly blurred. Stray strands rest near her cheeks and neck for a real, lived-in restaurant feel. Keep her soft oval face, delicate features, large eyes, natural nose bridge and gentle lip shape. Makeup follows a warm East Asian restaurant-selfie style: translucent base, natural straight brows, thin eyeliner, soft under-eye detail, light pink blush, rose-pink or muted bean-pink lips. Low contrast, clean, soft, no heavy makeup, no commercial retouch look.

She wears a white thin-strap camisole with lace trim, a small bow at the neckline, and tiny floral or dotted accents, layered under a warm cream or ivory loose knit cardigan. The cardigan shows visible vertical or open-knit texture and slips a little off one shoulder, revealing the thin strap. Fabric should read soft, warm and tactile: the cardigan looks fuzzy and knitted under warm light, the camisole looks lighter and more delicate.

Visible skin: face, neck, collarbone area, upper shoulders, a small sliver of upper chest, plus hands and wrists. Waist, stomach, back, hips and legs stay out of frame or covered by clothing. Skin tone sits between light warm ivory and soft beige-apricot, looking creamy and warm under yellow restaurant lighting. Face, neck, shoulders and collarbone skin should feel delicate, soft, faintly translucent, lightly moisturized. Keep subtle low-light tonal shifts, soft pores, natural shadows. Avoid over-smoothing or plastic skin.

Background is a nighttime restaurant, cafe or indoor dining space dressed with plants. Dense dark green indoor foliage, warm yellow background lamps, wooden partitions or window-like frames, softly blurred restaurant seating, dark wall surfaces, faint woven chair texture. Main light comes from warm yellow ceiling lamps and ambient back-of-room glow scattering from above and slightly behind, with weak environmental bounce from the front. It paints soft highlights on her forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, collarbone and shoulders. Plants and dark zones absorb some of the light, leaving warm shadows around the edges of her skin. Lamps filtering through leaves cast soft yellow light spots and irregular leaf-shadow shapes.

Keep a low-light smartphone texture: soft edges, mild shadow noise, warm film-like grain, subtle haze, slight compression. Face, hand and fork stay relatively crisp while background plants and warm lights fall into soft bokeh. Overall mood is gentle, quiet, intimate, warmly hazy, as if she had been sitting there for a while, fork in hand, paused mid-conversation, glancing up at the photographer right as the shot was taken.

prompts.promptZh:
一幅写实的低光手机风格肖像，描绘一位年轻成年女性夜晚坐在温馨的咖啡馆或餐厅内。半身紧框，大致为4：5或近方裁剪。相机保持胸部与面部高度，近距离拍摄，接近眼平或略高。她的脸、肩膀、脖子、手和上半身占据了画面的大部分空间。没有镜子自拍，没有手机遮住脸，更没有明亮的工作室风格。

她身体微微转动，手持金属叉子抵在下巴和嘴唇附近，仿佛晚餐的谈话在下一口前暂停了一顿。平静柔和的目光带着一丝好奇与镜头相遇。嘴唇微微张开或自然放松，没有大笑容。这张照片应该让人觉得是随意的抓拍，像是有人在桌子对面突然拍的，自然却略显镇定。

头发颜色为深黑棕色至自然黑色，松松地绑起或半束起，头顶柔软蓬松，两侧有松散的发丝框住面部。一层淡淡的暗光映照着温暖的低光，边缘略显模糊。散落的发丝贴在脸颊和脖子附近，营造出真实、有人居住的餐厅氛围。保持她柔和的椭圆形脸庞、精致的五官、大眼睛、自然的鼻梁和柔和的唇形。妆容遵循温暖的东亚餐厅自拍风格：半透明底妆、自然直眉、细细眼线、柔和的眼下细节、浅粉色腮红、玫瑰粉或柔和的豆粉唇唇。低对比度，干净柔和，没有浓妆，没有商业修饰的妆容。

她穿着白色细肩带吊带衫，带蕾丝边饰，领口系着小蝴蝶结，配以细小的花卉或点缀，外面叠穿温暖的奶油色或象牙色宽松针织开衫。开衫有明显的竖直或开放式织纹理，稍微滑落一侧肩膀，露出细肩带。面料应显得柔软、温暖且触感十足：开衫在温暖光线下看起来毛绒且针织，吊带衫则显得更轻盈细腻。

可见皮肤：面部、颈部、锁骨区域、上肩、上胸部一小片，以及手和手腕。腰部、腹部、背部、臀部和腿部保持画面外或被衣物遮挡。肤色介于浅暖象牙色和柔和米杏色之间，在餐厅黄色灯光下显得奶油般温暖。脸部、颈部、肩膀和锁骨皮肤应感觉细腻、柔软、微微透明，并略带滋润。保持细微的低光色调变化、柔软毛孔和自然阴影。避免过度光滑或塑料皮肤。

背景是夜间餐厅、咖啡馆或室内餐厅，装饰着植物。浓密的深绿色室内植被、温暖的黄色背景灯、木质隔断或窗框、柔和模糊的餐厅座椅、深色墙面、淡淡的编织椅质感。主光来自温暖的黄色天花板灯和从上方和稍后散射的房间后方环境光，前方环境反射较弱。它在她的额头、鼻梁、脸颊、锁骨和肩膀上绘制柔和的高光。植物和黑暗区域吸收了一些光线，在她皮肤边缘留下温暖的阴影。透过树叶的灯光投射出柔和的黄色光斑和不规则的叶影形状。

保持低光智能手机的贴图：柔和的边缘、轻微的阴影噪点、温暖的胶片状颗粒感、细微的雾气、轻微压缩。脸部、手部和叉子保持相对清晰，而背景植物和暖色灯光则呈现出柔和的散景。整体氛围温和、安静、亲密、温暖朦胧，仿佛她坐在那里，手握叉子，谈话中途停顿，拍摄时抬头看向摄影师。

prompts.title: 霓虹夜景产品主图 14
prompts.description: 适合包装设计师制作电商与产品素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE INSTRUCTION: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact source of truth for the product's appearance, color, finish, branding, and form factor. Do not invent or alter any product detail. Reproduce it with photorealistic precision.
---
Create a photorealistic premium [PRODUCT CATEGORY] campaign poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Design it as a clean global OOH, digital, and social campaign layout with strict grid alignment, premium white space, and precise typography. The campaign idea is "[CAMPAIGN TAGLINE]," but do not render that phrase as visible text.

Use a strict 12-column poster grid with 6% outer margins. Keep all text aligned to this grid. The image has four layers: background shape, giant background typography, subject/product photography, and clean graphic text overlays.

BACKGROUND: Pure matte white canvas. Place one large rounded-rectangle block behind the subject, occupying roughly 70% of the poster height and 76% of the width, centered slightly above the middle. The block uses a controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] gradient, glowing gently from top-left to bottom-right. Behind the subject and product, place giant cropped typography reading "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]" in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif letters. The word is a background layer only: huge, partially cropped by the frame edges, wide letter spacing, darker [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] than the rectangle, subtle embossed depth, soft shadow, and low enough contrast that it does not fight the product.

SUBJECT AND PRODUCT: [DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — e.g., "a female model with a clean editorial look, neutral confident expression, natural slightly wind-touched hair, muted off-white outfit, and [ACCENT COLOR] jacket"]. Shoot from a slightly low hero angle. Body angled for depth, face turned toward the viewer with direct eye contact. One hand extends toward the camera holding the product from the uploaded reference image. The product is the dominant foreground object, slightly tilted to reveal [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — e.g., "the triple camera system, brushed titanium edges, and centered brand logo"]. Keep the product sharp with realistic surface reflections, material texture, faint micro-details, and soft bloom around premium features. Keep the model's face readable behind it.

LIGHTING: Soft studio key light from front-left, warm rim light from the right, and subtle [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] bounce from the background block. Skin remains natural and non-airbrushed with realistic catchlights. Product edges have clean [MATERIAL FINISH — e.g., "metallic / matte / glossy"] highlights. Shadows are soft and controlled.

TYPOGRAPHY OVERLAY: All text must be flat, crisp, perfectly aligned graphic typography — not painted onto the scene. Render exactly these text elements once, with no extra text:

Top left, small black logo: [BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

Top right, thin sans-serif: "[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — e.g., 'Built for Apple Intelligence.']"

Mid left, glassmorphism pill: "[PRODUCT NAME — e.g., 'iPhone 17 Pro']"

Large background type: "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]"

Bottom right body copy, small clean sans-serif:
"[PRODUCT NAME]. [POWER STATEMENT — one sentence.]
[FEATURE 1]. [FEATURE 2].
[CLOSING LINE — e.g., 'Designed for what's next.']"

BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP: Place four equal-width glass-white rounded cards along the bottom, aligned to the grid, same height, same spacing, same baseline alignment. Each card has one minimal line icon above the heading. Render exactly:
Card 1: "[FEATURE HEADING 1]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]"
Card 2: "[FEATURE HEADING 2]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 2]"
Card 3: "[FEATURE HEADING 3]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 3]"
Card 4: "[FEATURE HEADING 4]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 4]"

GRAPHIC DETAILS: Two or three small sparkle icons only, subtle grain, soft glassmorphism, controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR]-white-[ACCENT COLOR] palette, no neon, no oversaturation.

prompts.promptZh:
参考图片说明：请使用上传的产品照片作为产品外观、颜色、表面处理、品牌和形态的准确依据。请勿虚构或更改任何产品细节。以照片级逼真精度还原。
---
制作一张照片级真实的高端[产品类别]广告海报，采用4：5垂直比例。设计成一个干净的全球户外广告、数字和社交活动布局，采用严格的网格对齐、优质留白和精准排版。该活动理念是“[竞选标语]”，但请不要将该短语呈现为可见文本。

使用严格的12列海报网格，外边距为6%。保持所有文本对齐于这个网格。图片有四层：背景形状、巨大的背景排版、主题/产品摄影，以及干净的图形文字叠加。

背景：纯哑光白色画布。在主体后方放置一个大型圆角矩形块，约占海报高度的70%，宽度的76%，稍高于中间。该块采用受控的[主品牌色]渐变，从左上到右下缓缓发光。在主题和产品后方，放置巨大的裁剪字体，上面用极粗的几何无衬线字体写着“[背景英雄词]”。这个词只是背景图层：体积庞大，被框架边缘部分裁剪，字母间距宽，[主品牌颜色]比矩形更深，细微的压印深度，柔和的阴影，对比度低到不会与产品格格不入。

主题与产品：[描述模特或主题——例如，“一位女性模特，拥有干净的编辑风格、中性自信的表情、自然的微风吹发型、柔和的米白色服装，以及[强调色]夹克”]。从略低的英雄角度拍摄。身体倾斜以求深度，脸朝向观者，目光直接交流。一只手伸向相机，手持上传参考图片中的产品。产品是前景的主导物体，略微倾斜以显示[关键产品细节——例如，“三摄系统、拉丝钛合金边缘和居中品牌标志”]。通过逼真的表面反射、材质质感、淡淡的微细节以及高端特征周围的柔和光晕，保持产品锐利。保持模特的脸部清晰可见。

灯光：来自前左的柔和演播室主光，右侧的暖边光，背景块上细微的[主色]反射。皮肤保持自然且未经过喷枪处理，配有逼真的捕捉光。产品边缘带有干净的[材料处理——例如“金属/哑光/光泽”]的高光。阴影柔和且受控。

字体叠加：所有文字必须是平面、清晰、完美对齐的图形排版——不能直接在场景上绘制。只渲染一次这些文本元素，不加多余文字：

左上角，小黑标志：[品牌标志名称/标志]

右上角，细无衬线字体：“[品牌副标语——例如，'为苹果智能打造']”

左中，玻璃形态药丸：“[产品名称 — 例如，'iPhone 17 Pro']”

大背景字体：“[背景英雄词]”

右下角正文，小而干净的无衬线字体：
“[产品名称]。[权力陈述——一句话。]
[特征1]。[特征2]。
[结尾行——例如，'为接下来的事设计。']”

底部特色条：在底部放置四张等宽的玻璃白色圆角卡，对齐网格，高度、间距相同、基线对齐相同。每张卡片标题上方有一个最小线条图标。精确渲染：
卡片1：“[特征标题1]” / “[特征子行1]”
卡片2：“[特征标题2]” / “[特征子行2]”
卡片3：“[特征标题3]” / “[特征子行3]”
卡片4：“[特征标题4]” / “[特征子行4]”

图形细节：仅用两三个小闪光图标，细腻的颗粒感，柔和的玻璃形态，受控的[品牌主色]-白色-[强调色]调色板，无霓虹色，无过度饱和。

prompts.title: 极简风格品牌海报 14
prompts.description: 适合视觉设计师制作海报与品牌素材，重点控制3D 渲染、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
EXPRESSIONIST SKETCH PORTRAIT
Subject name: {Enter Name Here}
Create a 4:5 vertical portrait art poster in the style of Expressionist drawing, inspired by Egon Schiele. The medium should evoke rough white sketch paper texture, using a high contrast monochromatic palette of deep black ink, charcoal grey, and raw white with raw emotional energy and a bold, gallery-quality feel.
Based on the uploaded reference photo, faithfully preserve the subject’s facial features, hairstyle, and personal aura in a half-body portrait composition. The rendering style is expressionist ink and charcoal portraiture, not photography, not cartoon, not anime. Facial details should be rendered with loose gestural lines, visible sketch marks, deliberate smudges, and intentionally unfinished areas that give the subject life and emotional intensity.
On the left side of the composition, write the subject’s full name in large bold expressive brushstroke lettering as a vertical column, with raw ink energy, line variation, and deliberate imperfection that matches the gestural drawing style. The name strokes should feel like they are drawn with the same hand and the same urgency as the portrait itself.
Based on the subject’s name, overall mood, and personal aura, automatically generate one elegant poetic English phrase of 8 to 12 words. The phrase should feel emotionally resonant and not modern colloquial, raw and honest and not overly obscure or kitschy, and deeply evocative of the subject’s inner spirit and temperament. Only this one generated phrase should appear in the composition with no repetition and no full-page text coverage.
This poetic phrase must be rendered in bold expressive brushstroke script and organically compose the contours of the figure, with the gestural letterforms bleeding directly into and tracing the subject’s head silhouette, hair flow, facial outline, neck, shoulder, and upper body lines. The viewer should feel as if the written words and the drawn figure share the same raw ink energy, as if the act of writing the phrase was the same act as drawing the person into existence.
Preserve large areas of raw open white space. In the lower left add loose gestural sketch marks suggesting ground or shadow. In the upper right add sparse expressive mark-making that suggests space and atmosphere without forming a clear image. These background elements must be raw and minimal and must never compete with the portrait.
Style keywords: Expressionist sketch portrait, Schiele-inspired drawing, gestural brushstroke lettering figure construction, high contrast ink and charcoal, figure outline formed by expressive letterforms, raw energy, emotional, bold, gallery-quality art poster.
Avoid: any Chinese characters or Asian script, cartoon or anime style, vivid colors, clean modern fonts, repetitive or excessive text, cluttered composition, overly refined digital art feel, commercial poster kitsch.

prompts.promptZh:
表现主义素描肖像
主题名称：{在此输入姓名}
创作一幅4：5竖直肖像艺术海报，采用表现主义绘画风格，灵感来自埃贡·席勒。媒介应唤起粗糙的白色素描纸质感，采用高对比单色调色板，包括深黑墨水、炭灰和原始白色，充满原始情感能量和大胆的画廊质感。
基于上传的参考照片，忠实地保留了被摄者的面部特征、发型和个人气质，呈现出半身肖像构图。其渲染风格采用表现主义墨水和炭笔肖像，非摄影、非卡通或动漫。面部细节应通过松散的手势线条、可见的草图痕迹、有意的污迹以及刻意未完成的区域来表现，赋予被写体生命力和情感张力。
在构图左侧，用大而粗体的笔触竖直写下主角的全名，带有原始的墨水能量、线条变化和有意的不完美，与手势绘画风格相匹配。名字笔触应当让人感觉像是用同一双手、同样紧迫地画出的。
根据主题的名字、整体情绪和个人气质，自动生成一个优雅诗意的英文短语，包含8到12个单词。这个短语应当情感共鸣，而非现代口语化，真实而真诚，不过于晦涩或俗气，深刻唤起被写者的内心精神和气质。仅应有这一生成的短语出现在作文中，不得重复，也不得覆盖整页文字。
这句诗意短语必须用大胆富有表现力的笔法表达，自然地构成人物轮廓，手势字母直接渗透并描摹主体的头部轮廓、发丝、面部轮廓、颈部、肩膀和上半身线条。观众应感受到文字与画中的人物共享相同的原始墨水能量，仿佛写下这句话的行为与将人物描绘成现实的行为是一样的。
保留大面积的原始开放白层。左下角添加松散的草图标记，暗示地面或阴影。右上角则加入稀疏的表现性笔触，暗示空间和氛围，却不形成清晰的画面。这些背景元素必须是原始且极简的，绝不能与肖像画竞争。
风格关键词：表现主义素描肖像、席勒启发的素描、笔触文字人物构造、高对比度墨水和炭笔、由富有表现力的字形形成的人物轮廓、原始能量、情感丰富、大胆、画廊级的艺术海报。
避免：任何汉字或亚洲文字、卡通或动漫风格、鲜艳色彩、干净的现代字体、重复或过多的文字、杂乱的构图、过于精致的数字艺术风格、商业海报的俗气内容。

prompts.description: 适合数据分析师制作信息图与知识素材，重点控制信息设计、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality vertical encyclopedia-style educational infographic
titled: "THE MANTIS SHRIMP — Nature's Most Dangerous Fist"

Subject: Peacock Mantis Shrimp (Odontodactylus scyllarus)

Overall style: Premium natural history field guide crossed with a
modern editorial science magazine. Clean cream/off-white background.
Soft teal, coral, and gold accent palette. Gentle drop shadows on all
panels. Small refined line icons. Rounded corner information boxes.
High information density without feeling crowded. Feels like a
collectible reference card from a scientific journal series.

—— LAYOUT STRUCTURE (top to bottom) ——

[HEADER BLOCK]
Large elegant serif title: "MANTIS SHRIMP"
Subtitle: "Odontodactylus scyllarus · Stomatopoda"
Small tagline badge: "The Ocean's Most Extraordinary Hunter"
Classification strip: Kingdom → Animalia | Phylum → Arthropoda |
Class → Malacostraca | Order → Stomatopoda

[MAIN HERO IMAGE]
One hyper-detailed full-color illustration of a Peacock Mantis Shrimp
in dramatic three-quarter profile view, raptorial claws extended.
Iridescent full-spectrum coloring. Scientifically accurate,
illustration style similar to a Smithsonian field guide plate.

[ANATOMY ZOOM PANELS — 3 circular close-up detail sections]
① Raptorial Dactyl Club — cross-section showing helicoidal fiber
   impact-absorbing structure, labeled: "Hits with the force of
   a .22 caliber bullet"
② Compound Eye — showing 16 photoreceptor types illustrated in
   spectrum bands, labeled: "Sees UV, infrared, and polarized light
   simultaneously"
③ Telson Shield — the armored tail plate used to block rival strikes,
   labeled: "Natural ballistic shield"

[QUICK STATS CARD — horizontal strip]
Icons + numbers in small rounded tiles:
• Strike Speed: 23 m/s (0.002 seconds)
• Strike Force: 1,500 Newtons
• Color Vision: 16 color channels (humans: 3)
• Lifespan: 20+ years
• Size: 2–7 inches
• Habitat Depth: 1–30 meters

[SUPERPOWER INDEX — visual scoring module]
Vertical bar or radial chart rating 6 abilities out of 10:
Strike Power ████████████ 10/10
Vision Range ████████████ 10/10
Armor Defense ████████░░░░ 8/10
Camouflage   ████████░░░░ 7/10
Intelligence  ██████░░░░░░ 6/10
Speed         █████████░░░ 9/10

[DUAL PANEL ROW]
Left panel — "HOW THE PUNCH WORKS"
Small sequential diagram: Load → Latch → Release → Cavitation Bubble
Collapse → Impact. Note: "The cavitation bubble hits the target a
second time even if the first strike misses."

Right panel — "VISION vs. HUMAN"
Simple comparison diagram:
Human eye = 3 cones (RGB)
Mantis Shrimp eye = 16 photoreceptors
+ UV + infrared + 6 polarization channels
Label: "Does NOT see more colors — processes light FASTER
than any known animal."

[HABITAT & RANGE PANEL]
Warm Indo-Pacific map with range shading.
Depth profile bar: Surface → 30m zone highlighted.
Notes: Rocky rubble, coral reef crevices.
Solitary, highly territorial.

[BEHAVIOR CARD]
Rounded box with 4 short bullet points:
• Monogamous — mates for life (up to 20 years together)
• Maintains and defends a permanent burrow
• Can recognize individual humans by face
• Communicates using fluorescent signals
  invisible to most predators

[WARNING / RISK PANEL — subtle red accent]
⚠ "Never house with other marine life.
   Will destroy aquarium glass over time.
   Has split human thumbnails during handling.
   Treat as a Level 3 biohazard during tank maintenance."

[FUN FACTS STRIP — "5 THINGS THAT SEEM FAKE"]
① Their clubs are stronger than bullet-proof ceramics
   — engineers are studying them for body armor
② They can see cancer cells in tissue that human eyes cannot
③ Some species glow under UV to communicate privately
④ Their strike creates a flash of light, heat, and shockwave —
   simultaneously
⑤ They have been known to break aquarium glass
   from the inside

[FOOTER BADGE ROW]
Three small rounded category tags:
[🌊 Marine Biology] [⚡ Biomechanics] [👁 Vision Science]
Small series label bottom right: "NATURAL WONDERS · Vol. 07"

Typography: Large bold condensed sans-serif for titles.
Clean readable serif for body text.
Monospaced for data/numbers.

Final feel: The image should look like it was pulled from
a $90 collector's edition nature encyclopedia.
Print-ready quality. NOT a poster. NOT an ad.
A knowledge artifact.

prompts.promptZh:
制作高质量的垂直百科全书式教育信息图
标题：《螳螂虾——大自然最危险的拳头》

主题：孔雀螳螂虾（Odontodactylus scyllarus）

整体风格：高端自然历史野外指南与
《现代编辑科学》杂志。干净的奶油色/米白色背景。
柔和的青绿色、珊瑚色和金色点缀。所有东西都用柔和的阴影
面板。小巧精炼的线条图标。圆角信息框。
高信息密度但不显拥挤。感觉像是
科学期刊系列的收藏参考卡。

—— 布局结构（由上到下）——

[标题块]
大号优雅衬线字体标题：“螳螂虾”
副标题：“Odontodactylus scyllarus ·足类”
小号标语徽章：“海洋最非凡的猎人”
分类条→：动物界 |节肢动物门→ |
马拉科斯特拉卡→级 |→足目

[主角图片]
一幅极为细致的全彩孔雀螳螂虾插图
在戏剧性的三分之三侧面视图中，猛禽的爪子伸出。
彩虹光全光谱着色。科学准确，
插图风格类似史密森学会的野外导向盘。

[解剖缩放面板——3个圆形特写细节部分]
（1） 猛禽指节俱乐部 — 剖面显示螺旋纤维
   吸震结构，标注为：“击打力量为
   一颗.22口径子弹”
（2）复眼——展示了16种感光细胞类型，示例如下
   光谱带，标注为：“能看到紫外线、红外线和偏振光
   同时”
（3） 特尔森盾——用于阻挡敌方攻击的装甲尾板，
   标注：“天然防弹盾”

[快速统计卡——横条]
图标+数字，小圆角方块：
• 打击速度：23米/秒（0.002秒）
• 打击力：1500牛顿
• 色觉：16个色道（人类：3个）
• 寿命：20+ 年
• 尺寸：2–7英寸
• 栖息地深度：1–30米

[超能力指数 — 视觉评分模块]
垂直条或径向图表评分：6项技能（满分10分）：
打击力████████████ 10/10
视力范围████████████10/10
装甲防御████████«« ́ 8/10
伪装████████«« ́ 7/10
智██████░░░░░░ 6/10
速度█████████« ★★ 9/10

[双面板排]
左侧面板——“拳击的原理”
小顺序图：负载→锁存→释放→空化气泡
崩溃→冲击。注：“空化气泡撞击目标 a
即使第一击没打中，第二次也要做。”

右侧面板——“视觉与人类”
简单的对比图：
人眼 = 3个视锥细胞（RGB）
螳螂虾眼 = 16个光感受器
+ 紫外 + 红外 + 6个偏振通道
标签：“看到的颜色不多——光处理更快
比任何已知的动物都多。”

[栖息地与分布区面板]
温暖的印太地图，带有范围阴影。
深度剖面条：30米区域→表面高亮。
备注：岩石碎石，珊瑚礁裂缝。
孤独，极具领地意识。

[行为卡]
圆角方框，带有4个简短的要点：
• 一夫一妻制——终身伴侣（最长20年）
• 维护和防御永久性洞穴
• 能够通过面部识别个体
• 使用荧光信号进行通信
  大多数捕食者看不见

[警告 / 风险面板——淡红色点缀]
⚠ “永远不要和其他海洋生物一起住。
   随着时间推移，水族箱玻璃会被破坏。
   在操作过程中，人类的拇指指甲被划裂了。
   在水箱维护期间，视为三级生物危害。”

[趣味趣闻连载——“5个看起来假的事物”]
（1）他们的棍棒比防弹陶瓷还要坚固
   ——工程师们正在研究它们用于防弹衣
（2）他们能看到人眼无法察觉的组织癌细胞
（3）有些物种在紫外线下发光以私下交流
（4）他们的攻击产生了一道闪光、热量和冲击波——
   同时进行
（5） 它们曾被发现会打破水族箱玻璃
   从内部

[地脚徽章排]
三个小圆润的类别标签：
[🌊海洋生物学][⚡生物力学][👁视觉科学]
右下角小系列标签：“自然奇观·第07卷”

排版：标题用大号加粗压缩无衬线字体。
正文用干净且可读的衬线。
数据和数字用宽宽。

最终感觉：图片应该看起来像是从那里拉出来的
一本90美元的收藏版《自然百科全书》。
印刷质量。不是海报。不是广告。
一个知识的神器。

prompts.title: 自然生态社媒视觉 14
prompts.description: 适合内容策划制作社交媒体素材，重点控制动漫插画、构图和信息层级。
prompts.prompt:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark chestnut brown"} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.
